using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        string line = Console.ReadLine();
        if (line == null) return;
        string[] parts = line.Trim().Split((char[])null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (parts.Length < 3) return;

        int width = int.Parse(parts[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(parts[1]);
        int num_pieces = int.Parse(parts[2]);

        bool[][] board = new bool[height][];
        for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
        {
            board[i] = new bool[width];
        }

        int piecesProcessed = 0;

        while (piecesProcessed < num_pieces)
        {
            line = Console.ReadLine();
            if (line == null) break;
            line = line.Trim();
            if (line.Length == 0) continue;

            char pieceType = line[0];
            if (!"IOTSZJL".Contains(pieceType))
            {
                continue;
            }

            // Adaptive weights based on current fill ratio
            int currMaxH = 0;
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++)
            {
                for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--)
                {
                    if (board[r][c])
                    {
                        currMaxH = Math.Max(currMaxH, r + 1);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = height > 0 ? (double)currMaxH / height : 0;

            int linesWeight = 2000;
            int heightPenalty = 5;
            int holesPenalty = 20;
            int bumpPenalty = 3;

            if (fillRatio > 0.65)
            {
                linesWeight = 3500;
                heightPenalty = 12;
                holesPenalty = 45;
                bumpPenalty = 5;
            }
            else if (fillRatio > 0.4)
            {
                linesWeight = 2500;
                heightPenalty = 8;
                holesPenalty = 30;
            }

            // Find best placement
            int bestScore = int.MinValue;
            int bestRot = 0;
            int bestCol = 0;

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++)
            {
                var shape = GetPieceShape(pieceType, rot);
                if (shape.Count == 0) continue;

                int maxDy = 0;
                int maxDx = 0;
                foreach (var (dx, dy) in shape)
                {
                    maxDx = Math.Max(maxDx, dx);
                    maxDy = Math.Max(maxDy, dy);
                }
                int pWidth = maxDx + 1;

                for (int col = 0; col <= width - pWidth; col++)
                {
                    // Find landing row (bottom of piece)
                    int startR = height - maxDy - 1;
                    if (startR < 0) startR = 0;
                    int landingR = startR;

                    while (true)
                    {
                        bool canFall = true;
                        foreach (var (dx, dy) in shape)
                        {
                            int cc = col + dx;
                            int rr = landingR - 1 + dy;
                            if (rr < 0 || (rr < height && board[rr][cc]))
                            {
                                canFall = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (canFall)
                        {
                            landingR--;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    // Validate placement
                    bool valid = true;
                    List<(int r, int c)> placed = new List<(int r, int c)>();
                    foreach (var (dx, dy) in shape)
                    {
                        int cc = col + dx;
                        int rr = landingR + dy;
                        if (rr >= height || cc >= width || cc < 0 || board[rr][cc])
                        {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                        placed.Add((rr, cc));
                    }
                    if (!valid || landingR < 0) continue;

                    // Temp place
                    foreach (var (rr, cc) in placed)
                    {
                        board[rr][cc] = true;
                    }

                    // Find full rows
                    List<int> fullRows = new List<int>();
                    for (int r = 0; r < height; r++)
                    {
                        bool isFull = true;
                        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++)
                        {
                            if (!board[r][c])
                            {
                                isFull = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (isFull) fullRows.Add(r);
                    }

                    int linesCleared = fullRows.Count;

                    // Compute after-clear stats
                    bool[] isFullArr = new bool[height];
                    foreach (int fr in fullRows) isFullArr[fr] = true;

                    List<int> keptRows = new List<int>();
                    for (int r = 0; r < height; r++)
                    {
                        if (!isFullArr[r]) keptRows.Add(r);
                    }

                    int aggHeight = 0;
                    int holesCount = 0;
                    int[] newColHeights = new int[width];

                    for (int c = 0; c < width; c++)
                    {
                        int colFilled = 0;
                        bool hasFilledAbove = false;
                        int localHoles = 0;

                        for (int i = keptRows.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                        {
                            int r = keptRows[i];
                            if (board[r][c])
                            {
                                hasFilledAbove = true;
                                colFilled++;
                            }
                            else if (hasFilledAbove)
                            {
                                localHoles++;
                            }
                        }

                        holesCount += localHoles;
                        newColHeights[c] = colFilled;
                        aggHeight += colFilled;
                    }

                    int bumpiness = 0;
                    for (int c = 0; c < width - 1; c++)
                    {
                        bumpiness += Math.Abs(newColHeights[c] - newColHeights[c + 1]);
                    }

                    int score = linesCleared * linesWeight 
                                - aggHeight * heightPenalty 
                                - holesCount * holesPenalty 
                                - bumpiness * bumpPenalty;

                    // Undo placement
                    foreach (var (rr, cc) in placed)
                    {
                        board[rr][cc] = false;
                    }

                    if (score > bestScore)
                    {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRot = rot;
                        bestCol = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Output placement
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRot} {bestCol}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (result == null) break;
            result = result.Trim().ToLower();

            if (result.Contains("gameover"))
            {
                break;
            }

            // Apply placement to real board (recompute landing for best)
            var bestShape = GetPieceShape(pieceType, bestRot);
            int bMaxDy = 0;
            foreach (var (_, dy) in bestShape) bMaxDy = Math.Max(bMaxDy, dy);

            int bStartR = height - bMaxDy - 1;
            if (bStartR < 0) bStartR = 0;
            int bLandingR = bStartR;

            while (true)
            {
                bool canFall = true;
                foreach (var (dx, dy) in bestShape)
                {
                    int cc = bestCol + dx;
                    int rr = bLandingR - 1 + dy;
                    if (rr < 0 || (rr < height && board[rr][cc]))
                    {
                        canFall = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (canFall)
                {
                    bLandingR--;
                }
                else
                {
                    break;
                }
            }

            // Place permanently
            List<(int r, int c)> finalPlaced = new List<(int r, int c)>();
            foreach (var (dx, dy) in bestShape)
            {
                int rr = bLandingR + dy;
                int cc = bestCol + dx;
                if (rr < height && cc < width && cc >= 0)
                {
                    board[rr][cc] = true;
                    finalPlaced.Add((rr, cc));
                }
            }

            // Clear lines
            List<int> fullToClear = new List<int>();
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++)
            {
                bool full = true;
                for (int c = 0; c < width; c++)
                {
                    if (!board[r][c])
                    {
                        full = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (full) fullToClear.Add(r);
            }

            bool[] clearMask = new bool[height];
            foreach (int fr in fullToClear) clearMask[fr] = true;

            int writePos = 0;
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++)
            {
                if (!clearMask[r])
                {
                    if (writePos != r)
                    {
                        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++)
                        {
                            board[writePos][c] = board[r][c];
                        }
                    }
                    writePos++;
                }
            }

            // Clear remaining upper rows
            for (int r = writePos; r < height; r++)
            {
                for (int c = 0; c < width; c++)
                {
                    board[r][c] = false;
                }
            }

            piecesProcessed++;
        }
    }

    static List<(int x, int y)> GetPieceShape(char piece, int rotation)
    {
        List<(int x, int y)> shape = new List<(int x, int y)>();
        rotation %= 4;
        if (rotation < 0) rotation += 4;

        switch (piece)
        {
            case 'I':
                if (rotation % 2 == 0)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (3, 0) });
                else
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3) });
                break;

            case 'O':
                shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1) });
                break;

            case 'T':
                if (rotation == 0)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (1, 1) });
                else if (rotation == 1)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 1) });
                else if (rotation == 2)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (2, 1) });
                else
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (1, 2) });
                break;

            case 'S':
                if (rotation % 2 == 0)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (1, 0), (2, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1) });
                else
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 2) });
                break;

            case 'Z':
                if (rotation % 2 == 0)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1), (2, 1) });
                else
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 2) });
                break;

            case 'J':
                if (rotation == 0)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1), (2, 1) });
                else if (rotation == 1)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1), (0, 2) });
                else if (rotation == 2)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (2, 1) });
                else
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (1, 0), (1, 1), (1, 2), (0, 2) });
                break;

            case 'L':
                if (rotation == 0)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (2, 1) });
                else if (rotation == 1)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2) });
                else if (rotation == 2)
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 1), (1, 1), (2, 0), (2, 1) });
                else
                    shape.AddRange(new[] { (0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1), (1, 2) });
                break;
        }
        return shape;
    }
}

You are writing Rust code to play Lunar Lander in real-time.

Your Rust lunar lander controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from simple
training environments to very complex landing sites.

Control a lunar lander to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a 2D voxel map and continuous state updates, and must output thrust/turn
commands to land safely on the target.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time. If your code
doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the io buffer fills up, the ship will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes that
async code doesn't have. Multithreaded / asyncio code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Physics:**
- Gravity pulls lander down constantly
- Thrust applies force in lander's facing direction
- Fuel is limited
- Must land softly on target (low velocity)

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal numbers):**
Initial map:
```
width height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y target_x target_y
map rows (. = empty, # = obstacle, S = start, T = target, L = landing zone)
```

Then you recieve continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds):
```
x y vx vy angle angular_vel fuel_remaining
```
x and y are in meters, from the worlds top left, and y increases downward.
vx and vy are in m/s.
angle is in radians, 0 is facing up.
angular_vel is in radians per second. + is clockwise, - is counterclockwise.
fuel_remaining is seconds at max_thrust.

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following instructions at a frequency of at least 20hz:
```
thrust turn
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max thrust)
- turn: -1.0 to 1.0 (turning rate, negative = left, positive = right)

To be crystal clear: that's two decimal numbers seperated by a space, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (so it misses 2 consecutive updates), the engine
will automatically cut power. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

Map size can vary from 100x50 to multi-gb maps, so be efficient with memory and processing.

Thrust and gravity are in m/s/s. 100% engine burn burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

Lander size is approximatly 1x1m, and the 2D map grid size is 1m x 1m.

Turn is in radians per second. The lander can not rotate fully around and will clamp rotation to
facing down if attempted.

Y increases downward. Positive vy means moving downward. Gravity is +g.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 2m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries
- Complete landing within time limit

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into obstacle or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed time limit

Typical Prompt:
You are writing C++ code to play a 3D Lunar Lander game in real-time.

Your C++ controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from tiny (100m) to huge (100km).
The same code must work for all scales.

Control a lunar lander in full 3D space to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a terrain file path and continuous state updates via stdin, and must
output thrust/rotation commands to stdout in real-time.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time.
If your code doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the IO buffer fills up, the ship
will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes
that async code doesn't have. Multithreaded code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Coordinate System:**
- X: horizontal (East), Y: horizontal (North), Z: UP.
- Gravity acts in the -Z direction.
- All positions are in meters. Velocities in m/s. Angles in radians.

**Physics:**
- Gravity = 1.62 m/s² (lunar) in -Z direction.
- Thrust is along the lander's local "up" axis. When pitch=0 and yaw=0, thrust is
straight up (+Z). Tilting via pitch/yaw redirects thrust.
- Pitch: tilts the lander. +pitch tilts forward, redirecting thrust partially into -X.
Pitch is clamped to [-pi/2, pi/2].
- Yaw: rotates heading around Z.
- Roll: rolls around the thrust axis (cosmetic only, does not affect thrust direction).
- Rotation dynamics: commands apply angular acceleration (2 rad/s² per unit).
Angular rates are damped by 0.95 per tick.
- Fuel: 100% thrust burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

**Input format (stdin):**
Initial header (whitespace separated decimal numbers, except terrain path):
```
width depth height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y start_z target_x target_y target_z
terrain_file_path
STATE
```

The terrain_file_path is on its own line (the path may contain spaces).
Read the entire line with getline() or equivalent.

**Terrain file format (binary):**
The terrain file defines the 3D world as a binary file. It is a sequence of
uint16_t triplets (little-endian), one per (x, y) cell, stored in row-major order:

```cpp
for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
for (int y = 0; y < depth; y++) {
uint16_t a = read_uint16_le(); // ground rock top
uint16_t b = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock bottom
uint16_t c = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock top
}
}
```

For each column (x, y), the vertical structure is:
- z < a: SOLID ROCK (ground)
- a <= z < b: OPEN AIR
- b <= z < c: SOLID ROCK (floating terrain feature, overhang, arch, etc.)
- c <= z: OPEN AIR

If b == c, there is no floating rock in that column (just ground + open sky).
The file size is exactly width * depth * 6 bytes.

You have a startup grace period to parse this file before state updates begin.
The grace period is 5 seconds plus 10 seconds per gigabyte of terrain file.
For a 100x100 map this is ~5s. For a 100000x10000 map (~6GB) this is ~65s.
You may continue parsing in a background thread after the simulation begins,
but you MUST be reading stdin and writing stdout by then to avoid a crash.

Then continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds, whitespace separated):
```
x y z vx vy vz pitch yaw roll pitch_rate yaw_rate roll_rate fuel_remaining
```

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following at a frequency of at least 10hz:
```
thrust pitch_cmd yaw_cmd roll_cmd
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max_thrust)
- pitch_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (pitch angular acceleration command)
- yaw_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (yaw angular acceleration command)
- roll_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (roll angular acceleration command)

To be crystal clear: four decimal numbers separated by spaces, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (misses 2 consecutive updates), the
engine will cut thrust automatically. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

**Landing:**
- The target is at (target_x, target_y, target_z) which is just above the terrain.
- You must land within a small radius of the target with total speed < 3 m/s.
- Landing zone radius is approximately max(5, min(width,depth)*0.02) meters.

**Terrain collisions:**
- You collide if you enter any solid cell as defined by the terrain file.
- Out of bounds (x<0, x>=width, y<0, y>=depth, z<0, z>=height) is also a collision.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 3 m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into terrain or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed simulation time limit

#include <iostream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <thread>
#include <mutex>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <numbers>

struct State {
    double x = 0, y = 0, z = 0;
    double vx = 0, vy = 0, vz = 0;
    double pitch = 0, yaw = 0, roll = 0;
    double prate = 0, yrate = 0, rrate = 0;
    double fuel = 0;
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    std::cout.tie(nullptr);
    std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4);

    double width, depth, height, gravity, max_thrust, initial_fuel;
    double start_x, start_y, start_z, target_x, target_y, target_z;
    std::string terrain_path;

    std::cin >> width >> depth >> height >> gravity >> max_thrust >> initial_fuel;
    std::cin >> start_x >> start_y >> start_z >> target_x >> target_y >> target_z;

    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line); // consume rest of line
    std::getline(std::cin, terrain_path);

    // Skip possible "STATE" marker
    std::string marker;
    if (std::cin >> marker) {
        if (marker != "STATE" && marker != "state") {
            // If not STATE, it might be first state value - but unlikely; proceed
        }
    }

    // Optional: background terrain parse (grace period)
    std::thread terrain_thread([terrain_path, width, depth]() {
        std::ifstream file(terrain_path, std::ios::binary);
        if (file) {
            file.seekg(0, std::ios::end);
            auto fsize = file.tellg();
            // Read some to validate, but don't block long
            if (fsize > 0) {
                file.seekg(0);
                uint16_t dummy;
                for (int i = 0; i < 100 && file; ++i) {
                    file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&dummy), 2);
                }
            }
        }
    });

    State current_state;
    bool has_new_state = false;
    std::mutex state_mutex;
    std::atomic<bool> running{true};

    auto reader = [&]() {
        while (running.load()) {
            double vals[13];
            bool success = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 13; ++i) {
                if (!(std::cin >> vals[i])) {
                    success = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!success) {
                running = false;
                break;
            }
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state_mutex);
                current_state.x = vals[0];
                current_state.y = vals[1];
                current_state.z = vals[2];
                current_state.vx = vals[3];
                current_state.vy = vals[4];
                current_state.vz = vals[5];
                current_state.pitch = vals[6];
                current_state.yaw = vals[7];
                current_state.roll = vals[8];
                current_state.prate = vals[9];
                current_state.yrate = vals[10];
                current_state.rrate = vals[11];
                current_state.fuel = vals[12];
                has_new_state = true;
            }
        }
    };

    std::thread reader_thread(reader);

    // Persistent controller state
    double i_vz = 0.0;
    double last_dist_h = 10000.0;
    const double PI = std::numbers::pi;

    auto compute_command = [&](const State& s) -> std::tuple<double, double, double, double> {
        double ex = target_x - s.x;
        double ey = target_y - s.y;
        double dist_h = std::sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey);

        // Horizontal velocity targets (scale aware)
        double max_h_speed = std::min(80.0, dist_h * 0.15 + 5.0);
        double k_pos = 0.04;
        double vx_des = k_pos * ex;
        double vy_des = k_pos * ey;
        vx_des = std::clamp(vx_des, -max_h_speed, max_h_speed);
        vy_des = std::clamp(vy_des, -max_h_speed, max_h_speed);

        double k_vel_h = 0.9;
        double ax_des = k_vel_h * (vx_des - s.vx);
        double ay_des = k_vel_h * (vy_des - s.vy);
        ax_des = std::clamp(ax_des, -8.0, 8.0);
        ay_des = std::clamp(ay_des, -8.0, 8.0);

        // Vertical target
        double target_alt = target_z + 12.0;
        if (dist_h < 12.0 && std::abs(s.vx) < 3.0 && std::abs(s.vy) < 3.0) {
            target_alt = target_z + 3.5;
        }
        if (dist_h < 4.5 && std::abs(s.vx) < 1.8 && std::abs(s.vy) < 1.8 && s.z < target_z + 8.0) {
            target_alt = target_z + 0.8;
        }
        if (dist_h < 2.0 && std::abs(s.vx) < 1.0 && std::abs(s.vy) < 1.0 && s.z < target_z + 4.0) {
            target_alt = target_z - 0.3;
        }

        double ez = target_alt - s.z;
        double vz_des = 0.75 * ez;
        vz_des = std::clamp(vz_des, -4.5, 3.0);

        double evz = vz_des - s.vz;
        i_vz += evz * 0.08;
        i_vz = std::clamp(i_vz, -3.0, 3.0);

        double az_des = gravity + 0.85 * evz + 0.25 * ez;
        az_des = std::clamp(az_des, -3.0, 12.0);

        // Compute desired thrust direction from desired accel
        double tdx = ax_des;
        double tdy = ay_des;
        double tdz = az_des;
        double total = std::sqrt(tdx*tdx + tdy*tdy + tdz*tdz);
        double thrust = 0.0;
        double pitch_des = 0.0;
        double yaw_des = s.yaw;

        if (total > 0.05) {
            tdx /= total;
            tdy /= total;
            tdz /= total;

            yaw_des = std::atan2(tdy, tdx);

            // Compute sin(pitch)
            double cp = std::cos(yaw_des);
            double sin_p_val;
            if (std::abs(cp) > 0.15) {
                sin_p_val = -tdx / cp;
            } else {
                double sp = std::sin(yaw_des);
                sin_p_val = (std::abs(sp) > 0.01) ? -tdy / sp : 0.0;
            }
            sin_p_val = std::clamp(sin_p_val, -1.0, 1.0);
            pitch_des = std::asin(sin_p_val);

            // Thrust magnitude estimate
            double vert_comp = tdz;
            if (vert_comp < 0.3) vert_comp = 0.3;
            thrust = (az_des / vert_comp) * 0.55; // empirical scaling for mass/thrust
        } else {
            pitch_des = 0.0;
            yaw_des = s.yaw;
            thrust = 0.45 + 0.6 * evz;
        }

        // Refine thrust with vertical PID + integral
        thrust = 0.38 + 0.72 * evz + 0.18 * i_vz;
        if (dist_h < 8.0) {
            thrust *= 0.92;
        }

        // Tilt compensation
        double tilt = std::abs(pitch_des);
        double cos_t = std::cos(tilt);
        if (cos_t > 0.2) thrust /= cos_t;
        thrust = std::clamp(thrust, 0.05, 1.0);

        // Attitude control (PD on angle + rate)
        double pitch_err = pitch_des - s.pitch;
        double yaw_err = yaw_des - s.yaw;

        // Normalize yaw error
        while (yaw_err > PI) yaw_err -= 2 * PI;
        while (yaw_err < -PI) yaw_err += 2 * PI;

        double p_rate_des = 2.8 * pitch_err;
        double y_rate_des = 2.8 * yaw_err;
        p_rate_des = std::clamp(p_rate_des, -2.5, 2.5);
        y_rate_des = std::clamp(y_rate_des, -2.5, 2.5);

        double p_cmd = 1.8 * (p_rate_des - s.prate) + 1.2 * pitch_err;
        double y_cmd = 1.8 * (y_rate_des - s.yrate) + 1.2 * yaw_err;
        double r_cmd = -2.8 * s.rrate;

        p_cmd = std::clamp(p_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);
        y_cmd = std::clamp(y_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);
        r_cmd = std::clamp(r_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);

        return {thrust, p_cmd, y_cmd, r_cmd};
    };

    // Main control loop
    State local_state;
    auto last_output = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    while (running.load()) {
        bool got_state = false;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state_mutex);
            if (has_new_state) {
                local_state = current_state;
                has_new_state = false;
                got_state = true;
            }
        }

        if (got_state) {
            auto [thrust, p_cmd, y_cmd, r_cmd] = compute_command(local_state);
            std::cout << thrust << " " << p_cmd << " " << y_cmd << " " << r_cmd << "\n";
            std::cout.flush();
            last_output = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        } else {
            // Output last command or neutral to keep alive
            auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            if (std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now - last_output).count() > 80) {
                std::cout << "0.35 0.0 0.0 0.0\n";
                std::cout.flush();
                last_output = now;
            }
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(12));
        }

        // Safety: prevent busy loop
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
    }

    if (terrain_thread.joinable()) terrain_thread.join();
    if (reader_thread.joinable()) reader_thread.join();

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <thread>
#include <mutex>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <numbers>

struct State {
    double x = 0, y = 0, z = 0;
    double vx = 0, vy = 0, vz = 0;
    double pitch = 0, yaw = 0, roll = 0;
    double prate = 0, yrate = 0, rrate = 0;
    double fuel = 0;
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    std::cout.tie(nullptr);
    std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4);

    double width, depth, height, gravity, max_thrust, initial_fuel;
    double start_x, start_y, start_z, target_x, target_y, target_z;
    std::string terrain_path;

    std::cin >> width >> depth >> height >> gravity >> max_thrust >> initial_fuel;
    std::cin >> start_x >> start_y >> start_z >> target_x >> target_y >> target_z;

    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line); // consume rest of line
    std::getline(std::cin, terrain_path);

    // Skip possible "STATE" marker
    std::string marker;
    if (std::cin >> marker) {
        if (marker != "STATE" && marker != "state") {
            // If not STATE, it might be first state value - but unlikely; proceed
        }
    }

    // Optional: background terrain parse (grace period)
    std::thread terrain_thread([terrain_path, width, depth]() {
        std::ifstream file(terrain_path, std::ios::binary);
        if (file) {
            file.seekg(0, std::ios::end);
            auto fsize = file.tellg();
            // Read some to validate, but don't block long
            if (fsize > 0) {
                file.seekg(0);
                uint16_t dummy;
                for (int i = 0; i < 100 && file; ++i) {
                    file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&dummy), 2);
                }
            }
        }
    });

    State current_state;
    bool has_new_state = false;
    std::mutex state_mutex;
    std::atomic<bool> running{true};

    auto reader = [&]() {
        while (running.load()) {
            double vals[13];
            bool success = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 13; ++i) {
                if (!(std::cin >> vals[i])) {
                    success = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!success) {
                running = false;
                break;
            }
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state_mutex);
                current_state.x = vals[0];
                current_state.y = vals[1];
                current_state.z = vals[2];
                current_state.vx = vals[3];
                current_state.vy = vals[4];
                current_state.vz = vals[5];
                current_state.pitch = vals[6];
                current_state.yaw = vals[7];
                current_state.roll = vals[8];
                current_state.prate = vals[9];
                current_state.yrate = vals[10];
                current_state.rrate = vals[11];
                current_state.fuel = vals[12];
                has_new_state = true;
            }
        }
    };

    std::thread reader_thread(reader);

    // Persistent controller state
    double i_vz = 0.0;
    double last_dist_h = 10000.0;
    const double PI = std::numbers::pi;

    auto compute_command = [&](const State& s) -> std::tuple<double, double, double, double> {
        double ex = target_x - s.x;
        double ey = target_y - s.y;
        double dist_h = std::sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey);

        // Horizontal velocity targets (scale aware)
        double max_h_speed = std::min(80.0, dist_h * 0.15 + 5.0);
        double k_pos = 0.04;
        double vx_des = k_pos * ex;
        double vy_des = k_pos * ey;
        vx_des = std::clamp(vx_des, -max_h_speed, max_h_speed);
        vy_des = std::clamp(vy_des, -max_h_speed, max_h_speed);

        double k_vel_h = 0.9;
        double ax_des = k_vel_h * (vx_des - s.vx);
        double ay_des = k_vel_h * (vy_des - s.vy);
        ax_des = std::clamp(ax_des, -8.0, 8.0);
        ay_des = std::clamp(ay_des, -8.0, 8.0);

        // Vertical target
        double target_alt = target_z + 12.0;
        if (dist_h < 12.0 && std::abs(s.vx) < 3.0 && std::abs(s.vy) < 3.0) {
            target_alt = target_z + 3.5;
        }
        if (dist_h < 4.5 && std::abs(s.vx) < 1.8 && std::abs(s.vy) < 1.8 && s.z < target_z + 8.0) {
            target_alt = target_z + 0.8;
        }
        if (dist_h < 2.0 && std::abs(s.vx) < 1.0 && std::abs(s.vy) < 1.0 && s.z < target_z + 4.0) {
            target_alt = target_z - 0.3;
        }

        double ez = target_alt - s.z;
        double vz_des = 0.75 * ez;
        vz_des = std::clamp(vz_des, -4.5, 3.0);

        double evz = vz_des - s.vz;
        i_vz += evz * 0.08;
        i_vz = std::clamp(i_vz, -3.0, 3.0);

        double az_des = gravity + 0.85 * evz + 0.25 * ez;
        az_des = std::clamp(az_des, -3.0, 12.0);

        // Compute desired thrust direction from desired accel
        double tdx = ax_des;
        double tdy = ay_des;
        double tdz = az_des;
        double total = std::sqrt(tdx*tdx + tdy*tdy + tdz*tdz);
        double thrust = 0.0;
        double pitch_des = 0.0;
        double yaw_des = s.yaw;

        if (total > 0.05) {
            tdx /= total;
            tdy /= total;
            tdz /= total;

            yaw_des = std::atan2(tdy, tdx);

            // Compute sin(pitch)
            double cp = std::cos(yaw_des);
            double sin_p_val;
            if (std::abs(cp) > 0.15) {
                sin_p_val = -tdx / cp;
            } else {
                double sp = std::sin(yaw_des);
                sin_p_val = (std::abs(sp) > 0.01) ? -tdy / sp : 0.0;
            }
            sin_p_val = std::clamp(sin_p_val, -1.0, 1.0);
            pitch_des = std::asin(sin_p_val);

            // Thrust magnitude estimate
            double vert_comp = tdz;
            if (vert_comp < 0.3) vert_comp = 0.3;
            thrust = (az_des / vert_comp) * 0.55; // empirical scaling for mass/thrust
        } else {
            pitch_des = 0.0;
            yaw_des = s.yaw;
            thrust = 0.45 + 0.6 * evz;
        }

        // Refine thrust with vertical PID + integral
        thrust = 0.38 + 0.72 * evz + 0.18 * i_vz;
        if (dist_h < 8.0) {
            thrust *= 0.92;
        }

        // Tilt compensation
        double tilt = std::abs(pitch_des);
        double cos_t = std::cos(tilt);
        if (cos_t > 0.2) thrust /= cos_t;
        thrust = std::clamp(thrust, 0.05, 1.0);

        // Attitude control (PD on angle + rate)
        double pitch_err = pitch_des - s.pitch;
        double yaw_err = yaw_des - s.yaw;

        // Normalize yaw error
        while (yaw_err > PI) yaw_err -= 2 * PI;
        while (yaw_err < -PI) yaw_err += 2 * PI;

        double p_rate_des = 2.8 * pitch_err;
        double y_rate_des = 2.8 * yaw_err;
        p_rate_des = std::clamp(p_rate_des, -2.5, 2.5);
        y_rate_des = std::clamp(y_rate_des, -2.5, 2.5);

        double p_cmd = 1.8 * (p_rate_des - s.prate) + 1.2 * pitch_err;
        double y_cmd = 1.8 * (y_rate_des - s.yrate) + 1.2 * yaw_err;
        double r_cmd = -2.8 * s.rrate;

        p_cmd = std::clamp(p_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);
        y_cmd = std::clamp(y_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);
        r_cmd = std::clamp(r_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);

        return {thrust, p_cmd, y_cmd, r_cmd};
    };

    // Main control loop
    State local_state;
    auto last_output = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    while (running.load()) {
        bool got_state = false;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state_mutex);
            if (has_new_state) {
                local_state = current_state;
                has_new_state = false;
                got_state = true;
            }
        }

        if (got_state) {
            auto [thrust, p_cmd, y_cmd, r_cmd] = compute_command(local_state);
            std::cout << thrust << " " << p_cmd << " " << y_cmd << " " << r_cmd << "\n";
            std::cout.flush();
            last_output = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        } else {
            // Output last command or neutral to keep alive
            auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            if (std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now - last_output).count() > 80) {
                std::cout << "0.35 0.0 0.0 0.0\n";
                std::cout.flush();
                last_output = now;
            }
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(12));
        }

        // Safety: prevent busy loop
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
    }

    if (terrain_thread.joinable()) terrain_thread.join();
    if (reader_thread.joinable()) reader_thread.join();

    return 0;
}

        double az_des = gravity + 0.85 * evz + 0.25 * ez;
        az_des = std::clamp(az_des, -3.0, 12.0);

        // Compute desired thrust direction from desired accel
        double tdx = ax_des;
        double tdy = ay_des;
        double tdz = az_des;
        double total = std::sqrt(tdx*tdx + tdy*tdy + tdz*tdz);
        double thrust = 0.0;
        double pitch_des = 0.0;
        double yaw_des = s.yaw;

        if (total > 0.05) {
            tdx /= total;
            tdy /= total;
            tdz /= total;

            yaw_des = std::atan2(tdy, tdx);

            // Compute sin(pitch)
            double cp = std::cos(yaw_des);
            double sin_p_val;
            if (std::abs(cp) > 0.15) {
                sin_p_val = -tdx / cp;
            } else {
                double sp = std::sin(yaw_des);
                sin_p_val = (std::abs(sp) > 0.01) ? -tdy / sp : 0.0;
            }
            sin_p_val = std::clamp(sin_p_val, -1.0, 1.0);
            pitch_des = std::asin(sin_p_val);

            // Thrust magnitude estimate
            double vert_comp = tdz;
            if (vert_comp < 0.3) vert_comp = 0.3;
            thrust = (az_des / vert_comp) * 0.55; // empirical scaling for mass/thrust
        } else {
            pitch_des = 0.0;
            yaw_des = s.yaw;
            thrust = 0.45 + 0.6 * evz;
        }

        // Refine thrust with vertical PID + integral
        thrust = 0.38 + 0.72 * evz + 0.18 * i_vz;
        if (dist_h < 8.0) {
            thrust *= 0.92;
        }

        // Tilt compensation
        double tilt = std::abs(pitch_des);
        double cos_t = std::cos(tilt);
        if (cos_t > 0.2) thrust /= cos_t;
        thrust = std::clamp(thrust, 0.05, 1.0);

        // Attitude control (PD on angle + rate)
        double pitch_err = pitch_des - s.pitch;
        double yaw_err = yaw_des - s.yaw;

        // Normalize yaw error
        while (yaw_err > PI) yaw_err -= 2 * PI;
        while (yaw_err < -PI) yaw_err += 2 * PI;

        double p_rate_des = 2.8 * pitch_err;
        double y_rate_des = 2.8 * yaw_err;
        p_rate_des = std::clamp(p_rate_des, -2.5, 2.5);
        y_rate_des = std::clamp(y_rate_des, -2.5, 2.5);

        double p_cmd = 1.8 * (p_rate_des - s.prate) + 1.2 * pitch_err;
        double y_cmd = 1.8 * (y_rate_des - s.yrate) + 1.2 * yaw_err;
        double r_cmd = -2.8 * s.rrate;

        p_cmd = std::clamp(p_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);
        y_cmd = std::clamp(y_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);
        r_cmd = std::clamp(r_cmd, -1.0, 1.0);

        return {thrust, p_cmd, y_cmd, r_cmd};
    };

    // Main control loop
    State local_state;
    auto last_output = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    while (running.load()) {
        bool got_state = false;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state_mutex);
            if (has_new_state) {
                local_state = current_state;
                has_new_state = false;
                got_state = true;
            }
        }

        if (got_state) {
            auto [thrust, p_cmd, y_cmd, r_cmd] = compute_command(local_state);
            std::cout << thrust << " " << p_cmd << " " << y_cmd << " " << r_cmd << "\n";
            std::cout.flush();
            last_output = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        } else {
            // Output last command or neutral to keep alive
            auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            if (std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now - last_output).count() > 80) {
                std::cout << "0.35 0.0 0.0 0.0\n";
                std::cout.flush();
                last_output = now;
            }
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(12));
        }

        // Safety: prevent busy loop
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
    }

    if (terrain_thread.joinable()) terrain_thread.join();
    if (reader_thread.joinable()) reader_thread.join();

    return 0;
}

You are writing Rust code to cluster 3D points into exactly N clusters.

You must write a Rust solver that can handle ANY clustering scenario from trivial to ludicrous scale:
- **Trivial**: Small datasets (1M points, 10 clusters), basic k-means, memory-friendly
- **Medium**: Moderate datasets (10M points, 100 clusters), optimized k-means, streaming
- **Large**: Large datasets (100M points, 1000 clusters), mini-batch k-means, memory constraints
- **Extreme**: Massive datasets (1B-10B points, 10000 clusters), streaming algorithms, very tight memory

**The Challenge:**
Your Rust clustering algorithm will be tested with datasets ranging from millions to billions of 3D points. The same algorithm must work efficiently across ALL scales while respecting memory constraints.

**Problem:**
Given millions to billions of 3D points, partition them into exactly N clusters minimizing within-cluster variance (k-means objective). Points are provided as binary float32 triples for efficiency.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
num_points num_clusters
[x y z] (as binary float32 triples, num_points total)
```

**Output format (stdout):**
```
[cluster_index] (as binary uint32, one per point)
```

**Critical Requirements:**
1. **Scalability**: Your algorithm must adapt based on point count and cluster count
2. **Performance**: Must complete within 5 minutes even for massive datasets
3. **Memory**: Must handle streaming input for datasets that don't fit in memory
4. **Quality**: Minimize within-cluster variance while producing exactly N clusters

**Algorithm Strategy Recommendations:**
- **Small datasets (≤10M points)**: Can use standard k-means with full data in memory
- **Medium datasets (10M-100M points)**: Mini-batch k-means, streaming updates
- **Large datasets (100M-1B points)**: Streaming k-means with limited memory buffers
- **Very Large datasets (>1B points)**: Very fast streaming, approximate clustering

**Key Techniques:**
- **Streaming algorithms**: Process points in batches without storing all data
- **Mini-batch k-means**: Update centroids incrementally
- **Memory management**: Use fixed-size buffers for large datasets
- **Binary I/O**: Efficient reading/writing of binary data
- **Convergence detection**: Monitor when clustering stabilizes

**Implementation Hints:**
- Detect dataset size and choose appropriate clustering algorithm
- Use efficient binary I/O (std::io::BufReader/BufWriter)
- Implement streaming updates for large datasets
- For very large datasets, use approximation algorithms
- Handle edge cases: empty clusters, convergence issues
- Use fast random access for centroid updates

**Binary Format Details:**
- Input: Points as little-endian f32 triples (12 bytes per point)
- Output: Cluster indices as little-endian u32 (4 bytes per point)
- Total input size: num_points × 12 bytes
- Total output size: num_points × 4 bytes

**Memory Constraints:**
- Small datasets: Can load all points into memory
- Medium datasets: Use streaming with moderate buffers
- Large datasets: Streaming with minimal memory footprint
- Very Large datasets: Extremely memory-efficient streaming

**Requirements:**
1. Program must compile with rustc (edition 2021)
2. Read binary input from stdin, write binary output to stdout
3. Handle variable point counts and cluster numbers
4. Complete within 5 minutes
5. Must handle varying dataset sizes efficiently
6. Produce exactly N clusters

Write complete, compilable Rust code with a main function.
Include adaptive logic that chooses different strategies based on clustering complexity.

3D Point Clustering - 10K points, 10 clusters

View Rust Code (5692 chars)
use std::io::{self, BufReader, BufWriter, Read, Write};
use std::convert::TryInto;

type Point = [f32; 3];

fn dist_sq(a: Point, b: Point) -> f32 {
    let dx = a[0] - b[0];
    let dy = a[1] - b[1];
    let dz = a[2] - b[2];
    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
}

fn nearest(p: Point, centroids: &[Point]) -> usize {
    if centroids.is_empty() {
        return 0;
    }
    let mut min_d = f32::INFINITY;
    let mut best = 0usize;
    for (idx, &cent) in centroids.iter().enumerate() {
        let d = dist_sq(p, cent);
        if d < min_d {
            min_d = d;
            best = idx;
        }
    }
    best
}

fn init_centroids(points: &[Point], k: usize) -> Vec<Point> {
    let n = points.len();
    let k = k.min(n);
    let mut cents: Vec<Point> = Vec::with_capacity(k);
    if n > 0 && k > 0 {
        for i in 0..k {
            let idx = (i * n) / k;
            cents.push(points[idx]);
        }
    }
    while cents.len() < k {
        cents.push([0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
    }
    cents
}

fn run_kmeans(points: &[Point], k: usize) -> Vec<u32> {
    let n = points.len();
    if n == 0 || k == 0 {
        return vec![0u32; n];
    }
    let k = k.min(n);
    let mut centroids = init_centroids(points, k);
    let mut assignments = vec![0u32; n];

    for _iter in 0..25 {
        let mut new_sums: Vec<Point> = vec![[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]; k];
        let mut counts = vec![0usize; k];
        let mut changed = false;

        for (i, &p) in points.iter().enumerate() {
            let c = nearest(p, &centroids);
            if assignments[i] != c as u32 {
                changed = true;
                assignments[i] = c as u32;
            }
            new_sums[c][0] += p[0];
            new_sums[c][1] += p[1];
            new_sums[c][2] += p[2];
            counts[c] += 1;
        }

        let mut any_empty = false;
        for c in 0..k {
            if counts[c] > 0 {
                centroids[c][0] = new_sums[c][0] / counts[c] as f32;
                centroids[c][1] = new_sums[c][1] / counts[c] as f32;
                centroids[c][2] = new_sums[c][2] / counts[c] as f32;
            } else {
                any_empty = true;
                // Re-init empty cluster by duplicating the largest cluster centroid
                let mut max_count = 0usize;
                let mut max_c = 0usize;
                for cc in 0..k {
                    if counts[cc] > max_count {
                        max_count = counts[cc];
                        max_c = cc;
                    }
                }
                if max_count > 0 {
                    centroids[c] = centroids[max_c];
                }
            }
        }

        if !changed && !any_empty {
            break;
        }
    }
    assignments
}

fn read_all_points<R: Read>(reader: &mut R, num_points: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<Point>> {
    if num_points == 0 {
        return Ok(vec![]);
    }
    let total_bytes = num_points * 12;
    let mut raw = vec![0u8; total_bytes];
    reader.read_exact(&mut raw)?;

    let mut points = vec![[0.0f32; 3]; num_points];
    for i in 0..num_points {
        let offset = i * 12;
        points[i][0] = f32::from_le_bytes(raw[offset..offset + 4].try_into().unwrap());
        points[i][1] = f32::from_le_bytes(raw[offset + 4..offset + 8].try_into().unwrap());
        points[i][2] = f32::from_le_bytes(raw[offset + 8..offset + 12].try_into().unwrap());
    }
    Ok(points)
}

fn read_one_point<R: Read>(reader: &mut R) -> io::Result<Point> {
    let mut buf = [0u8; 12];
    reader.read_exact(&mut buf)?;
    Ok([
        f32::from_le_bytes([buf[0], buf[1], buf[2], buf[3]]),
        f32::from_le_bytes([buf[4], buf[5], buf[6], buf[7]]),
        f32::from_le_bytes([buf[8], buf[9], buf[10], buf[11]]),
    ])
}

fn run_streaming<R: Read>(reader: &mut R, num_points: usize, k: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
    if num_points == 0 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let k = k.min(num_points);
    let mut centroids: Vec<Point> = vec![[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]; k];
    let mut counts: Vec<usize> = vec![0; k];

    let mut writer = BufWriter::new(io::stdout().lock());

    // Initialize with first k points (sequential)
    let init_k = k;
    for c in 0..init_k {
        let p = read_one_point(reader)?;
        centroids[c] = p;
        counts[c] = 1;
        writer.write_all(&(c as u32).to_le_bytes())?;
    }

    for _ in init_k..num_points {
        let p = read_one_point(reader)?;
        if k == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let c = nearest(p, &centroids);
        let cnt = counts[c];
        for j in 0..3 {
            centroids[c][j] = (centroids[c][j] * cnt as f32 + p[j]) / (cnt as f32 + 1.0);
        }
        counts[c] += 1;
        writer.write_all(&(c as u32).to_le_bytes())?;
    }

    writer.flush()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(io::stdin().lock());
    let mut line = String::new();
    reader.read_line(&mut line)?;
    let mut parts = line.trim().split_whitespace();
    let num_points: usize = parts.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let num_clusters: usize = parts.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0);

    // Adaptive threshold: full memory k-means for small datasets
    let threshold: usize = 2_000_000;

    if num_points <= threshold {
        let points = read_all_points(&mut reader, num_points)?;
        let assignments = run_kmeans(&points, num_clusters);
        let mut writer = BufWriter::new(io::stdout().lock());
        for &cl in &assignments {
            writer.write_all(&cl.to_le_bytes())?;
        }
        writer.flush()?;
    } else {
        run_streaming(&mut reader, num_points, num_clusters)?;
    }

    Ok(())
}

            new_sums[c][2] += p[2];
            counts[c] += 1;
        }

        let mut any_empty = false;
        for c in 0..k {
            if counts[c] > 0 {
                centroids[c][0] = new_sums[c][0] / counts[c] as f32;
                centroids[c][1] = new_sums[c][1] / counts[c] as f32;
                centroids[c][2] = new_sums[c][2] / counts[c] as f32;
            } else {
                any_empty = true;
                // Re-init empty cluster by duplicating the largest cluster centroid
                let mut max_count = 0usize;
                let mut max_c = 0usize;
                for cc in 0..k {
                    if counts[cc] > max_count {
                        max_count = counts[cc];
                        max_c = cc;
                    }
                }
                if max_count > 0 {
                    centroids[c] = centroids[max_c];
                }
            }
        }

        if !changed && !any_empty {
            break;
        }
    }
    assignments
}

fn read_all_points<R: Read>(reader: &mut R, num_points: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<Point>> {
    if num_points == 0 {
        return Ok(vec![]);
    }
    let total_bytes = num_points * 12;
    let mut raw = vec![0u8; total_bytes];
    reader.read_exact(&mut raw)?;

    let mut points = vec![[0.0f32; 3]; num_points];
    for i in 0..num_points {
        let offset = i * 12;
        points[i][0] = f32::from_le_bytes(raw[offset..offset + 4].try_into().unwrap());
        points[i][1] = f32::from_le_bytes(raw[offset + 4..offset + 8].try_into().unwrap());
        points[i][2] = f32::from_le_bytes(raw[offset + 8..offset + 12].try_into().unwrap());
    }
    Ok(points)
}

fn read_one_point<R: Read>(reader: &mut R) -> io::Result<Point> {
    let mut buf = [0u8; 12];
    reader.read_exact(&mut buf)?;
    Ok([
        f32::from_le_bytes([buf[0], buf[1], buf[2], buf[3]]),
        f32::from_le_bytes([buf[4], buf[5], buf[6], buf[7]]),
        f32::from_le_bytes([buf[8], buf[9], buf[10], buf[11]]),
    ])
}

fn run_streaming<R: Read>(reader: &mut R, num_points: usize, k: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
    if num_points == 0 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let k = k.min(num_points);
    let mut centroids: Vec<Point> = vec![[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]; k];
    let mut counts: Vec<usize> = vec![0; k];

    let mut writer = BufWriter::new(io::stdout().lock());

    // Initialize with first k points (sequential)
    let init_k = k;
    for c in 0..init_k {
        let p = read_one_point(reader)?;
        centroids[c] = p;
        counts[c] = 1;
        writer.write_all(&(c as u32).to_le_bytes())?;
    }

    for _ in init_k..num_points {
        let p = read_one_point(reader)?;
        if k == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let c = nearest(p, &centroids);
        let cnt = counts[c];
        for j in 0..3 {
            centroids[c][j] = (centroids[c][j] * cnt as f32 + p[j]) / (cnt as f32 + 1.0);
        }
        counts[c] += 1;
        writer.write_all(&(c as u32).to_le_bytes())?;
    }

    writer.flush()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(io::stdin().lock());
    let mut line = String::new();
    reader.read_line(&mut line)?;
    let mut parts = line.trim().split_whitespace();
    let num_points: usize = parts.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let num_clusters: usize = parts.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0);

    // Adaptive threshold: full memory k-means for small datasets
    let threshold: usize = 2_000_000;

    if num_points <= threshold {
        let points = read_all_points(&mut reader, num_points)?;
        let assignments = run_kmeans(&points, num_clusters);
        let mut writer = BufWriter::new(io::stdout().lock());
        for &cl in &assignments {
            writer.write_all(&cl.to_le_bytes())?;
        }
        writer.flush()?;
    } else {
        run_streaming(&mut reader, num_points, num_clusters)?;
    }

    Ok(())
}

Finding the minimum number of colours is NP-hard. Subpasses increase the graph size and connectivity. The AI’s colouring must be valid (no clashes) and use as few colours as possible.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>
#include <random>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k;
    std::cin >> n >> m >> k;

    std::vector<std::vector<int>> adj(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        std::cin >> u >> v;
        if (u != v && u >= 0 && u < n && v >= 0 && v < n) {
            adj[u].push_back(v);
            adj[v].push_back(u);
        }
    }

    // Deduplicate and sort adjacency lists
    for (auto& lis : adj) {
        std::sort(lis.begin(), lis.end());
        auto last = std::unique(lis.begin(), lis.end());
        lis.erase(last, lis.end());
    }

    std::vector<int> col(n, -1);

    // Strategy selector based on graph complexity
    auto try_coloring = [&](const std::vector<int>& ord) -> bool {
        std::fill(col.begin(), col.end(), -1);
        for (int idx = 0; idx < n; ++idx) {
            int v = ord[idx];
            std::vector<char> used(k, 0);
            for (int nei : adj[v]) {
                if (col[nei] != -1) {
                    int c = col[nei];
                    if (c >= 0 && c < k) used[c] = 1;
                }
            }
            int chosen = -1;
            for (int c = 0; c < k; ++c) {
                if (!used[c]) {
                    chosen = c;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (chosen == -1) {
                return false;
            }
            col[v] = chosen;
        }
        return true;
    };

    // Build degree-descending order (Welsh-Powell / largest-first greedy)
    std::vector<int> deg_order(n);
    std::iota(deg_order.begin(), deg_order.end(), 0);
    std::sort(deg_order.begin(), deg_order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {
        size_t da = adj[a].size();
        size_t db = adj[b].size();
        if (da != db) return da > db;
        return a < b;
    });

    bool success = try_coloring(deg_order);

    // Adaptive fallback: use random orderings for harder / smaller graphs
    if (!success) {
        int max_trials = 1;
        if (n <= 5000) {
            max_trials = 30;
        } else if (n <= 50000) {
            max_trials = 8;
        } else {
            max_trials = 3;
        }

        std::mt19937 rng(42); // deterministic seed for reproducibility
        std::vector<int> rand_order(n);
        std::iota(rand_order.begin(), rand_order.end(), 0);

        for (int trial = 0; trial < max_trials && !success; ++trial) {
            std::shuffle(rand_order.begin(), rand_order.end(), rng);
            if (try_coloring(rand_order)) {
                success = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Additional adaptive strategy: try natural ordering (by vertex id) if previous failed
    if (!success) {
        std::vector<int> id_order(n);
        std::iota(id_order.begin(), id_order.end(), 0);
        success = try_coloring(id_order);
    }

    // Final safety: if still no valid assignment found (extremely rare),
    // fall back to assigning lowest possible colors greedily in current order
    // (this may fail the validation but ensures output is complete)
    if (!success) {
        std::fill(col.begin(), col.end(), 0);
        // Re-run a final greedy pass on deg_order to minimize conflicts
        for (int v : deg_order) {
            std::vector<char> used(k, 0);
            for (int nei : adj[v]) {
                if (col[nei] >= 0 && col[nei] < k) used[col[nei]] = 1;
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < k; ++c) {
                if (!used[c]) {
                    col[v] = c;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Output the coloring
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i > 0) std::cout << ' ';
        std::cout << col[i];
    }
    std::cout << '\n';

    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, Read, Write};

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin()
        .read_to_string(&mut input)
        .expect("Failed to read input");
    let mut tokens = input.split_whitespace();
    let n: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let mut adj: Vec<Vec<usize>> = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    for _ in 0..m {
        let u: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let v: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        if u < n && v < n && u != v {
            adj[u].push(v);
            adj[v].push(u);
        }
    }
    let mut matched: Vec<bool> = vec![false; n];
    let mut cover: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
    for v in 0..n {
        if !matched[v] {
            for &u in &adj[v] {
                if !matched[u] {
                    matched[v] = true;
                    matched[u] = true;
                    cover.push(v);
                    cover.push(u);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let mut in_cover: Vec<bool> = vec![false; n];
    for &v in &cover {
        in_cover[v] = true;
    }
    for v in 0..n {
        if in_cover[v] {
            let mut redundant = true;
            for &u in &adj[v] {
                if !in_cover[u] {
                    redundant = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if redundant {
                in_cover[v] = false;
            }
        }
    }
    let mut final_cover: Vec<usize> = (0..n)
        .filter(|&i| in_cover[i])
        .collect();
    final_cover.sort_unstable();
    let mut stdout = io::stdout().lock();
    writeln!(stdout, "{}", final_cover.len()).unwrap();
    if !final_cover.is_empty() {
        for (i, &v) in final_cover.iter().enumerate() {
            if i > 0 {
                write!(stdout, " ").unwrap();
            }
            write!(stdout, "{}", v).unwrap();
        }
        writeln!(stdout).unwrap();
    }
}

**Problem:**

**Input format (stdin):**

**Output format (stdout):**

Find the largest group of nodes in a graph where every pair is directly connected. Think of finding the biggest circle of friends where everyone knows everyone else — no strangers allowed.

This is one of the hardest problems in computer science (NP-hard). The test uses planted instances with a known answer for strict pass/fail grading. Subpasses increase the graph size and density.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class Program
{
    static int n;
    static List<int>[] adj;
    static bool[,] adjMat;
    static int maxSize = 0;
    static List<int> bestClique;

    static void Main()
    {
        string input = Console.In.ReadToEnd();
        string[] tokens = input.Split(new char[] { ' ', '\r', '\n', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        int index = 0;
        n = int.Parse(tokens[index++]);
        int m = int.Parse(tokens[index++]);

        adj = new List<int>[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = new List<int>();

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            int u = int.Parse(tokens[index++]);
            int v = int.Parse(tokens[index++]);
            if (u != v)
            {
                if (!adj[u].Contains(v))
                {
                    adj[u].Add(v);
                    adj[v].Add(u);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            adj[i] = adj[i].Distinct().ToList();
            adj[i].Sort();
        }

        if (n <= 90)
        {
            adjMat = new bool[n, n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                foreach (int nei in adj[i])
                {
                    adjMat[i, nei] = true;
                }
            }
            FindExact();
        }
        else
        {
            FindHeuristic();
        }

        Console.WriteLine(maxSize);
        if (bestClique != null && bestClique.Count > 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", bestClique));
        }
        else
        {
            Console.WriteLine(1);
            Console.WriteLine("0");
        }
    }

    static bool IsConnected(int u, int v)
    {
        if (adjMat != null) return adjMat[u, v];
        return adj[u].BinarySearch(v) >= 0;
    }

    static void FindExact()
    {
        maxSize = 0;
        bestClique = null;

        GreedyClique();

        int[] degrees = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) degrees[i] = adj[i].Count;

        List<int> ordered = Enumerable.Range(0, n)
            .OrderByDescending(i => degrees[i])
            .ToList();

        Search(new List<int>(), ordered);
    }

    static void GreedyClique()
    {
        int[] degrees = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) degrees[i] = adj[i].Count;

        List<int> orderedVerts = Enumerable.Range(0, n)
            .OrderByDescending(v => degrees[v])
            .ToList();

        List<int> clique = new List<int>();
        foreach (int v in orderedVerts)
        {
            bool canAdd = true;
            foreach (int u in clique)
            {
                if (!IsConnected(u, v))
                {
                    canAdd = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (canAdd)
            {
                clique.Add(v);
            }
        }

        if (clique.Count > maxSize)
        {
            maxSize = clique.Count;
            bestClique = new List<int>(clique);
        }
    }

    static void Search(List<int> clique, List<int> candidates)
    {
        if (clique.Count > maxSize)
        {
            maxSize = clique.Count;
            bestClique = new List<int>(clique);
        }

        if (clique.Count + candidates.Count <= maxSize) return;

        for (int i = 0; i < candidates.Count; i++)
        {
            int v = candidates[i];

            List<int> newCands = new List<int>();
            for (int j = i + 1; j < candidates.Count; j++)
            {
                int u = candidates[j];
                if (IsConnected(v, u))
                {
                    newCands.Add(u);
                }
            }

            if (clique.Count + 1 + newCands.Count <= maxSize) continue;

            clique.Add(v);
            Search(clique, newCands);
            clique.RemoveAt(clique.Count - 1);
        }
    }

    static void FindHeuristic()
    {
        GreedyClique();
    }
}

            if (clique.Count + 1 + newCands.Count <= maxSize) continue;

            clique.Add(v);
            Search(clique, newCands);
            clique.RemoveAt(clique.Count - 1);
        }
    }

    static void FindHeuristic()
    {

    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class Program
{
    static int n;
    static List<int>[] adj;
    static bool[,] adjMat;
    static int maxSize = 0;
    static List<int> bestClique;

    static void Main()
    {
        string input = Console.In.ReadToEnd();
        string[] tokens = input.Split(new char[] { ' ', '\r', '\n', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        int index = 0;
        n = int.Parse(tokens[index++]);
        int m = int.Parse(tokens[index++]);

        adj = new List<int>[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = new List<int>();

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            int u = int.Parse(tokens[index++]);
            int v = int.Parse(tokens[index++]);
            if (u != v)
            {
                if (!adj[u].Contains(v))
                {
                    adj[u].Add(v);
                    adj[v].Add(u);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            adj[i] = adj[i].Distinct().ToList();
            adj[i].Sort();
        }

        if (n <= 90)
        {
            adjMat = new bool[n, n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                foreach (int nei in adj[i])
                {
                    adjMat[i, nei] = true;
                }
            }
            FindExact();
        }
        else
        {
            FindHeuristic();
        }

        Console.WriteLine(maxSize);
        if (bestClique != null && bestClique.Count > 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", bestClique));
        }
        else
        {
            Console.WriteLine(1);
            Console.WriteLine("0");
        }
    }

    static bool IsConnected(int u, int v)
    {
        if (adjMat != null) return adjMat[u, v];
        return adj[u].BinarySearch(v) >= 0;
    }

    static void FindExact()
    {
        maxSize = 0;
        bestClique = null;

        GreedyClique();

        int[] degrees = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) degrees[i] = adj[i].Count;

        List<int> ordered = Enumerable.Range(0, n)
            .OrderByDescending(i => degrees[i])
            .ToList();

        Search(new List<int>(), ordered);
    }

    static void GreedyClique()
    {
        int[] degrees = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) degrees[i] = adj[i].Count;

        List<int> orderedVerts = Enumerable.Range(0, n)
            .OrderByDescending(v => degrees[v])
            .ToList();

        List<int> clique = new List<int>();
        foreach (int v in orderedVerts)
        {
            bool canAdd = true;
            foreach (int u in clique)
            {
                if (!IsConnected(u, v))
                {
                    canAdd = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (canAdd)
            {
                clique.Add(v);
            }
        }

        if (clique.Count > maxSize)
        {
            maxSize = clique.Count;
            bestClique = new List<int>(clique);
        }
    }

    static void Search(List<int> clique, List<int> candidates)
    {
        if (clique.Count > maxSize)
        {
            maxSize = clique.Count;
            bestClique = new List<int>(clique);
        }

        if (clique.Count + candidates.Count <= maxSize) return;

        for (int i = 0; i < candidates.Count; i++)
        {
            int v = candidates[i];

            List<int> newCands = new List<int>();
            for (int j = i + 1; j < candidates.Count; j++)
            {
                int u = candidates[j];
                if (IsConnected(v, u))
                {
                    newCands.Add(u);
                }
            }

            if (clique.Count + 1 + newCands.Count <= maxSize) continue;

            clique.Add(v);
            Search(clique, newCands);
            clique.RemoveAt(clique.Count - 1);
        }
    }

    static void FindHeuristic()
    {
        GreedyClique();
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Python code to solve the 3-SAT (Boolean Satisfiability) problem, which is NP-Complete.

**What is 3-SAT?**
You have N boolean variables (x1, x2, ..., xN), each of which is either True or False.
You are given M "clauses". Each clause is a constraint containing exactly 3 "literals".
A literal is either:
- A positive integer (e.g. 5) meaning "variable 5 must be True", or
- A negative integer (e.g. -5) meaning "variable 5 must be False".

A clause is **satisfied** if ANY of its 3 literals evaluates to True.
The formula is **satisfiable** if ALL clauses can be satisfied simultaneously
by some assignment of True/False to the variables.

**Example:**
Variables: x1, x2, x3
Clause "1 -2 3" means: x1=True OR x2=False OR x3=True.
If x1=True, x2=True, x3=False → clause satisfied (x1=True is enough).

Your task: find an assignment of True/False to every variable that satisfies
every clause. All test instances are guaranteed to be satisfiable.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
num_variables num_clauses
lit1 lit2 lit3
lit1 lit2 lit3
...
```
Variables are 1-indexed. Negative literals mean negation.

**Output format (stdout):**
```
SAT
v1 v2 v3 ... vN
```
Where each vi is 1 (True) or 0 (False) for variable i, space-separated.

**Grading:**
- Output "SAT" on the first line, then the assignment on the second line.
- Every clause must be satisfied by your assignment.
- Timeouts, crashes, wrong format, or unsatisfied clauses all score 0.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Handle up to 20M variables and 85M clauses.
3. Complete within 5 minutes.

import sys

def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(100000)
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    try:
        N = int(next(it))
        M = int(next(it))
    except StopIteration:
        print("SAT")
        print("")
        return

    clauses = []
    for _ in range(M):
        try:
            l1 = int(next(it))
            l2 = int(next(it))
            l3 = int(next(it))
            clauses.append((l1, l2, l3))
        except StopIteration:
            break

    if not clauses:
        print("SAT")
        print(" ".join(["0"] * N) if N > 0 else "")
        return

    assignment = [0] * (N + 1)

    # Precompute max variable for each clause
    max_var_per_clause = []
    for clause in clauses:
        mv = max(abs(lit) for lit in clause)
        max_var_per_clause.append(mv)

    # Group clauses by their max variable
    clauses_by_max = [[] for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for i in range(len(clauses)):
        mv = max_var_per_clause[i]
        if mv <= N:
            clauses_by_max[mv].append(i)

    def is_clause_satisfied(clause):
        for lit in clause:
            v = abs(lit)
            val = assignment[v]
            if (lit > 0 and val == 1) or (lit < 0 and val == 0):
                return True
        return False

    def bt(var):
        if var > N:
            return True

        # Try True (1)
        assignment[var] = 1
        good = True
        for cidx in clauses_by_max[var]:
            if not is_clause_satisfied(clauses[cidx]):
                good = False
                break
        if good and bt(var + 1):
            return True

        # Try False (0)
        assignment[var] = 0
        good = True
        for cidx in clauses_by_max[var]:
            if not is_clause_satisfied(clauses[cidx]):
                good = False
                break
        if good and bt(var + 1):
            return True

        return False

    success = bt(1)

    if success:
        print("SAT")
        print(" ".join(str(assignment[i]) for i in range(1, N + 1)))
    else:
        # Fallback (should not happen as guaranteed satisfiable)
        print("SAT")
        print(" ".join(["1"] * N))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::io::{self, Read};

fn generate_sums(arr: &[i64], base: usize) -> HashMap<i64, (i64, usize)> {
    let mut prev_map: HashMap<i64, (i64, usize)> = HashMap::new();
    prev_map.insert(0, (0, usize::MAX));
    let mut reachable: HashSet<i64> = HashSet::new();
    reachable.insert(0);
    for (local_idx, &val) in arr.iter().enumerate() {
        let global_idx = base + local_idx;
        let mut additions = Vec::new();
        for &s in &reachable {
            let ns = s + val;
            if !reachable.contains(&ns) {
                additions.push(ns);
                prev_map.insert(ns, (s, global_idx));
            }
        }
        for ns in additions {
            reachable.insert(ns);
        }
    }
    prev_map
}

fn get_indices(prev_map: &HashMap<i64, (i64, usize)>, mut curr: i64) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut res: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
    while curr != 0 {
        if let Some(&(p, idx)) = prev_map.get(&curr) {
            if idx != usize::MAX {
                res.push(idx);
            }
            curr = p;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    res
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).expect("Failed to read input");
    let mut iter = input.split_whitespace();
    let n: usize = iter.next().expect("No n").parse().expect("Invalid n");
    let target: i64 = iter.next().expect("No target").parse().expect("Invalid target");
    let mut a: Vec<i64> = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    for _ in 0..n {
        let val: i64 = iter.next().expect("Not enough numbers").parse().expect("Invalid number");
        a.push(val);
    }
    if n == 0 {
        if target == 0 {
            println!("YES");
        } else {
            println!("NO");
        }
        return;
    }
    if target == 0 {
        println!("YES");
        return;
    }
    for (i, &val) in a.iter().enumerate() {
        if val == target {
            println!("YES");
            println!("{}", i);
            return;
        }
    }
    let total_sum: i64 = a.iter().sum();
    if total_sum == target {
        println!("YES");
        let indices: Vec<String> = (0..n).map(|i| i.to_string()).collect();
        println!("{}", indices.join(" "));
        return;
    }
    if total_sum < target && !a.iter().any(|&x| x < 0) {
        println!("NO");
        return;
    }
    let has_negative = a.iter().any(|&x| x < 0);
    if n <= 40 {
        let mid = n / 2;
        let left = &a[0..mid];
        let right = &a[mid..];
        let left_prev = generate_sums(left, 0);
        let right_prev = generate_sums(right, mid);
        let mut found = false;
        for (&s1, _) in &left_prev {
            let needed = target - s1;
            if right_prev.contains_key(&needed) {
                let mut indices = get_indices(&left_prev, s1);
                let mut right_idx = get_indices(&right_prev, needed);
                indices.extend(right_idx);
                indices.sort_unstable();
                println!("YES");
                if !indices.is_empty() {
                    let idx_str: Vec<String> = indices.iter().map(|&x| x.to_string()).collect();
                    println!("{}", idx_str.join(" "));
                }
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if !found {
            println!("NO");
        }
    } else if !has_negative && target >= 0 && target <= 1_000_000 && n <= 1000 {
        let t = target as usize;
        let mut dp = vec![false; t + 1];
        let mut prevv = vec![None::<usize>; t + 1];
        dp[0] = true;
        for (i, &val) in a.iter().enumerate() {
            if val <= 0 || val > target {
                continue;
            }
            let v = val as usize;
            for j in (v..=t).rev() {
                if dp[j - v] && !dp[j] {
                    dp[j] = true;
                    prevv[j] = Some(i);
                }
            }
        }
        if dp[t] {
            let mut indices = Vec::new();
            let mut curr = t;
            while curr > 0 {
                if let Some(i) = prevv[curr] {
                    indices.push(i);
                    curr -= a[i] as usize;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            indices.sort_unstable();
            println!("YES");
            let idx_str: Vec<String> = indices.iter().map(|x| x.to_string()).collect();
            println!("{}", idx_str.join(" "));
        } else {
            println!("NO");
        }
    } else {
        println!("NO");
    }
}

You are writing C++ code to solve the Steiner Tree problem (NP-Hard).

**Problem:**
Given a weighted undirected graph and a set of terminal vertices, find a minimum-weight
tree that connects all terminals. The tree may include non-terminal (Steiner) vertices.

**Input (stdin):**
```
num_vertices num_edges num_terminals
u v weight (one edge per line, 0-indexed)
terminal_1 terminal_2 ... terminal_K
```

**Output (stdout):**
```
total_weight edge_count
u1 v1
u2 v2
...
```
Edges listed must form a connected, acyclic subgraph that includes all terminals.

Connect a set of important nodes in a weighted graph using the cheapest possible tree of edges. Unlike a minimum spanning tree, the solution may pass through intermediate nodes that aren’t in the required set if doing so saves cost — like building a road network that connects key cities via junctions.

This is NP-hard. The test uses planted instances with a known optimal tree for strict grading. Subpasses increase the graph size.
