Early subpasses test trivial tactics (hanging pieces, mate in one). Middle subpasses present classic chess puzzles requiring short tactical sequences. Later subpasses pit the engine against Stockfish at rising ELO levels, from absolute beginner (100) to grandmaster strength (2500).

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <chrono>
#include <algorithm>
#include <map>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

struct Move {
    int from;
    int to;
    char promotion;
    bool capture;
};

struct UndoInfo {
    char captured;
    string old_castling;
    int old_ep;
    int old_half;
    char original_piece;
    bool castling;
    int rook_from;
    int rook_to;
    bool was_en_passant;
    int ep_capture_sq;
};

char board[64];
char current_side;
string castling_rights;
int ep_square;
int halfmove_clock;
int fullmove_number;

map<char, int> piece_value = {
    {'P', 100}, {'N', 320}, {'B', 330}, {'R', 500}, {'Q', 900}, {'K', 20000},
    {'p', -100}, {'n', -320}, {'b', -330}, {'r', -500}, {'q', -900}, {'k', -20000}
};

string sq_to_str(int sq) {
    if (sq < 0 || sq > 63) return "";
    char file = 'a' + (sq % 8);
    char rank = '1' + (sq / 8);
    return string(1, file) + rank;
}

int str_to_sq(const string& s) {
    if (s == "-" || s.empty()) return -1;
    return (s[0] - 'a') + 8 * (s[1] - '1');
}

void load_fen(const string& fen) {
    stringstream ss(fen);
    string board_part, active, castle, enp, half, full;
    ss >> board_part >> active >> castle >> enp >> half >> full;
    int index = 0;
    for (char c : board_part) {
        if (c == '/') continue;
        if (isdigit(c)) {
            int skip = c - '0';
            for (int i = 0; i < skip; i++) {
                if (index < 64) board[index++] = '.';
            }
        } else if (isalpha(c)) {
            if (index < 64) board[index++] = c;
        }
    }
    current_side = active[0];
    castling_rights = castle;
    ep_square = str_to_sq(enp);
    halfmove_clock = stoi(half);
    fullmove_number = stoi(full);
}

int find_king(char side) {
    char king = (side == 'w') ? 'K' : 'k';
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        if (board[i] == king) return i;
    }
    return -1;
}

bool is_attacked(int sq, char by_side) {
    if (sq < 0 || sq > 63) return false;
    int f = sq % 8;
    int r = sq / 8;

    // Pawns
    if (by_side == 'w') {
        if (r > 0) {
            if (f < 7 && board[(r-1)*8 + (f+1)] == 'P') return true;
            if (f > 0 && board[(r-1)*8 + (f-1)] == 'P') return true;
        }
    } else {
        if (r < 7) {
            if (f < 7 && board[(r+1)*8 + (f+1)] == 'p') return true;
            if (f > 0 && board[(r+1)*8 + (f-1)] == 'p') return true;
        }
    }

    // Knights
    int knight_deltas[8] = {-17, -15, -10, -6, 6, 10, 15, 17};
    for (int d : knight_deltas) {
        int nsq = sq + d;
        if (nsq >= 0 && nsq < 64) {
            int fd = abs((nsq % 8) - (sq % 8));
            int rd = abs((nsq / 8) - (sq / 8));
            if ((fd == 1 && rd == 2) || (fd == 2 && rd == 1)) {
                char p = board[nsq];
                if ((by_side == 'w' && p == 'N') || (by_side == 'b' && p == 'n')) return true;
            }
        }
    }

    // King
    int king_deltas[8] = {-9, -8, -7, -1, 1, 7, 8, 9};
    for (int d : king_deltas) {
        int nsq = sq + d;
        if (nsq >= 0 && nsq < 64) {
            int fd = abs((nsq % 8) - (sq % 8));
            int rd = abs((nsq / 8) - (sq / 8));
            if (fd <= 1 && rd <= 1) {
                char p = board[nsq];
                if ((by_side == 'w' && p == 'K') || (by_side == 'b' && p == 'k')) return true;
            }
        }
    }

    // Sliding - Rook/Queen orthogonal
    int rook_dfs[4] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    int rook_drs[4] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        int df = rook_dfs[i];
        int dr = rook_drs[i];
        int cf = f;
        int cr = r;
        while (true) {
            cf += df;
            cr += dr;
            if (cf < 0 || cf > 7 || cr < 0 || cr > 7) break;
            int nsq = cr * 8 + cf;
            char p = board[nsq];
            if (p != '.') {
                if ((by_side == 'w' && (p == 'R' || p == 'Q')) || (by_side == 'b' && (p == 'r' || p == 'q'))) return true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Sliding - Bishop/Queen diagonal
    int bishop_dfs[4] = {-1, 1, -1, 1};
    int bishop_drs[4] = {-1, -1, 1, 1};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        int df = bishop_dfs[i];
        int dr = bishop_drs[i];
        int cf = f;
        int cr = r;
        while (true) {
            cf += df;
            cr += dr;
            if (cf < 0 || cf > 7 || cr < 0 || cr > 7) break;
            int nsq = cr * 8 + cf;
            char p = board[nsq];
            if (p != '.') {
                if ((by_side == 'w' && (p == 'B' || p == 'Q')) || (by_side == 'b' && (p == 'b' || p == 'q'))) return true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    return false;
}

bool is_in_check(char side) {
    int ksq = find_king(side);
    if (ksq == -1) return true;
    char opp = (side == 'w' ? 'b' : 'w');
    return is_attacked(ksq, opp);
}

UndoInfo make_move(Move m) {
    UndoInfo u;
    u.captured = board[m.to];
    u.old_castling = castling_rights;
    u.old_ep = ep_square;
    u.old_half = halfmove_clock;
    u.original_piece = board[m.from];
    u.castling = false;
    u.rook_from = -1;
    u.rook_to = -1;
    u.was_en_passant = false;
    u.ep_capture_sq = -1;

    char piece = board[m.from];
    bool is_pawn = (tolower(piece) == 'p');
    bool is_king = (tolower(piece) == 'k');
    bool is_rook_move = (tolower(piece) == 'r');

    board[m.to] = piece;
    board[m.from] = '.';

    if (m.promotion != 0) {
        board[m.to] = m.promotion;
    }

    // En passant
    if (is_pawn && ep_square != -1 && m.to == ep_square) {
        u.was_en_passant = true;
        u.ep_capture_sq = (current_side == 'w' ? m.to - 8 : m.to + 8);
        u.captured = board[u.ep_capture_sq];
        board[u.ep_capture_sq] = '.';
    }

    // Castling
    if (is_king && abs(m.to - m.from) == 2) {
        u.castling = true;
        if (m.to > m.from) { // kingside
            u.rook_from = (current_side == 'w') ? 7 : 63;
            u.rook_to = (current_side == 'w') ? 5 : 61;
        } else { // queenside
            u.rook_from = (current_side == 'w') ? 0 : 56;
            u.rook_to = (current_side == 'w') ? 3 : 59;
        }
        board[u.rook_to] = board[u.rook_from];
        board[u.rook_from] = '.';
    }

    // Update castling rights
    if (is_king) {
        string newc = "";
        for (char c : castling_rights) {
            if (current_side == 'w') {
                if (c != 'K' && c != 'Q') newc += c;
            } else {
                if (c != 'k' && c != 'q') newc += c;
            }
        }
        castling_rights = newc;
    }
    if (is_rook_move) {
        if (current_side == 'w') {
            if (m.from == 7) castling_rights.erase(remove(castling_rights.begin(), castling_rights.end(), 'K'), castling_rights.end());
            if (m.from == 0) castling_rights.erase(remove(castling_rights.begin(), castling_rights.end(), 'Q'), castling_rights.end());
        } else {
            if (m.from == 63) castling_rights.erase(remove(castling_rights.begin(), castling_rights.end(), 'k'), castling_rights.end());
            if (m.from == 56) castling_rights.erase(remove(castling_rights.begin(), castling_rights.end(), 'q'), castling_rights.end());
        }
    }

    // EP
    ep_square = -1;
    if (is_pawn && abs(m.to - m.from) == 16) {
        ep_square = (m.from + m.to) / 2;
    }

    // Halfmove
    if (is_pawn || u.captured != '.') {
        halfmove_clock = 0;
    } else {
        halfmove_clock++;
    }

    // Switch side
    current_side = (current_side == 'w' ? 'b' : 'w');

    return u;
}

void unmake_move(Move m, UndoInfo u) {
    board[m.from] = u.original_piece;

    if (u.castling) {
        board[m.to] = '.';
        board[u.rook_from] = board[u.rook_to];
        board[u.rook_to] = '.';
    } else if (u.was_en_passant) {
        board[m.to] = '.';
        board[u.ep_capture_sq] = u.captured;
    } else {
        board[m.to] = u.captured;
    }

    castling_rights = u.old_castling;
    ep_square = u.old_ep;
    halfmove_clock = u.old_half;

    current_side = (current_side == 'w' ? 'b' : 'w');
}

vector<Move> generate_pseudo_moves() {
    vector<Move> moves;
    char my_pawn = (current_side == 'w' ? 'P' : 'p');
    for (int sq = 0; sq < 64; sq++) {
        char piece = board[sq];
        if (piece == '.') continue;
        bool white_piece = isupper(piece);
        if ((current_side == 'w' && !white_piece) || (current_side == 'b' && white_piece)) continue;

        if (tolower(piece) == 'p') {
            int dir = (current_side == 'w' ? 8 : -8);
            int start_r = (current_side == 'w' ? 1 : 6);
            int promo_r = (current_side == 'w' ? 7 : 0);
            // forward
            int to = sq + dir;
            if (to >= 0 && to < 64 && board[to] == '.') {
                if ((sq / 8) == promo_r) {
                    vector<char> promos = {'Q', 'R', 'B', 'N'};
                    for (char pr : promos) {
                        char promo_p = (current_side == 'w' ? pr : tolower(pr));
                        moves.push_back({sq, to, promo_p, false});
                    }
                } else {
                    moves.push_back({sq, to, 0, false});
                }
                if ((sq / 8) == start_r) {
                    int to2 = sq + 2 * dir;
                    if (to2 >= 0 && to2 < 64 && board[to2] == '.') {
                        moves.push_back({sq, to2, 0, false});
                    }
                }
            }
            // captures
            int cap_d[2] = {dir - 1, dir + 1};
            for (int d : cap_d) {
                int to_c = sq + d;
                if (to_c >= 0 && to_c < 64 && abs((to_c % 8) - (sq % 8)) == 1) {
                    char targ = board[to_c];
                    if (targ != '.' && ((current_side == 'w' && islower(targ)) || (current_side == 'b' && isupper(targ)))) {
                        if ((sq / 8) == promo_r) {
                            vector<char> promos = {'Q', 'R', 'B', 'N'};
                            for (char pr : promos) {
                                char promo_p = (current_side == 'w' ? pr : tolower(pr));
                                moves.push_back({sq, to_c, promo_p, true});
                            }
                        } else {
                            moves.push_back({sq, to_c, 0, true});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            // en passant
            if (ep_square != -1) {
                for (int d : cap_d) {
                    int to_c = sq + d;
                    if (to_c == ep_square && abs((to_c % 8) - (sq % 8)) == 1) {
                        moves.push_back({sq, to_c, 0, true});
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (tolower(piece) == 'n') {
            int deltas[8] = {-17,-15,-10,-6,6,10,15,17};
            for (int d : deltas) {
                int to = sq + d;
                if (to >= 0 && to < 64) {
                    int fd = abs((to % 8) - (sq % 8));
                    int rd = abs((to / 8) - (sq / 8));
                    if ((fd == 1 && rd == 2) || (fd == 2 && rd == 1)) {
                        char targ = board[to];
                        if (targ == '.' || (current_side == 'w' && islower(targ)) || (current_side == 'b' && isupper(targ))) {
                            moves.push_back({sq, to, 0, (targ != '.')});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (tolower(piece) == 'b' || tolower(piece) == 'r' || tolower(piece) == 'q') {
            vector<pair<int, int>> dirs;
            if (tolower(piece) == 'b' || tolower(piece) == 'q') {
                dirs.emplace_back(-1, -1); dirs.emplace_back(-1, 1);
                dirs.emplace_back(1, -1); dirs.emplace_back(1, 1);
            }
            if (tolower(piece) == 'r' || tolower(piece) == 'q') {
                dirs.emplace_back(-1, 0); dirs.emplace_back(1, 0);
                dirs.emplace_back(0, -1); dirs.emplace_back(0, 1);
            }
            for (auto [df, dr] : dirs) {
                int cf = sq % 8;
                int cr = sq / 8;
                while (true) {
                    cf += df;
                    cr += dr;
                    if (cf < 0 || cf > 7 || cr < 0 || cr > 7) break;
                    int to = cr * 8 + cf;
                    char targ = board[to];
                    if (targ == '.') {
                        moves.push_back({sq, to, 0, false});
                    } else {
                        if ((current_side == 'w' && islower(targ)) || (current_side == 'b' && isupper(targ))) {
                            moves.push_back({sq, to, 0, true});
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (tolower(piece) == 'k') {
            int deltas[8] = {-9,-8,-7,-1,1,7,8,9};
            for (int d : deltas) {
                int to = sq + d;
                if (to >= 0 && to < 64) {
                    int fd = abs((to % 8) - (sq % 8));
                    int rd = abs((to / 8) - (sq / 8));
                    if (fd <= 1 && rd <= 1) {
                        char targ = board[to];
                        if (targ == '.' || (current_side == 'w' && islower(targ)) || (current_side == 'b' && isupper(targ))) {
                            moves.push_back({sq, to, 0, (targ != '.')});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            // Castling pseudo
            if (current_side == 'w') {
                if (castling_rights.find('K') != string::npos && board[5] == '.' && board[6] == '.') {
                    moves.push_back({sq, 6, 0, false});
                }
                if (castling_rights.find('Q') != string::npos && board[1] == '.' && board[2] == '.' && board[3] == '.') {
                    moves.push_back({sq, 2, 0, false});
                }
            } else {
                if (castling_rights.find('k') != string::npos && board[61] == '.' && board[62] == '.') {
                    moves.push_back({sq, 62, 0, false});
                }
                if (castling_rights.find('q') != string::npos && board[57] == '.' && board[58] == '.' && board[59] == '.') {
                    moves.push_back({sq, 58, 0, false});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return moves;
}

vector<Move> generate_legal_moves() {
    vector<Move> pseudo = generate_pseudo_moves();
    vector<Move> legal;
    for (auto m : pseudo) {
        if (tolower(board[m.from]) == 'k' && abs(m.to - m.from) == 2) {
            if (is_in_check(current_side)) continue;
            // Basic path check for castling
            if (current_side == 'w') {
                if (m.to == 6) { // O-O
                    if (is_attacked(5, 'b') || is_attacked(6, 'b')) continue;
                } else if (m.to == 2) { // O-O-O
                    if (is_attacked(3, 'b') || is_attacked(2, 'b') || is_attacked(1, 'b')) continue;
                }
            } else {
                if (m.to == 62) {
                    if (is_attacked(61, 'w') || is_attacked(62, 'w')) continue;
                } else if (m.to == 58) {
                    if (is_attacked(59, 'w') || is_attacked(58, 'w') || is_attacked(57, 'w')) continue;
                }
            }
        }
        UndoInfo u = make_move(m);
        char mover_side = (current_side == 'w' ? 'b' : 'w');
        if (!is_in_check(mover_side)) {
            legal.push_back(m);
        }
        unmake_move(m, u);
    }
    return legal;
}

int evaluate() {
    int score = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        if (board[i] != '.') {
            auto it = piece_value.find(board[i]);
            if (it != piece_value.end()) score += it->second;
        }
    }
    return score;
}

int alpha_beta(int depth, int alpha, int beta, chrono::steady_clock::time_point start_time, double timeout) {
    auto now = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    double elapsed = chrono::duration<double>(now - start_time).count();
    if (elapsed > timeout - 0.3) return evaluate();

    if (depth == 0) return evaluate();

    vector<Move> moves = generate_legal_moves();
    if (moves.empty()) {
        if (is_in_check(current_side)) {
            return (current_side == 'w' ? -20000 : 20000);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    for (auto& m : moves) {
        now = chrono::steady_clock::now();
        elapsed = chrono::duration<double>(now - start_time).count();
        if (elapsed > timeout - 0.3) break;

        UndoInfo u = make_move(m);
        int score = -alpha_beta(depth - 1, -beta, -alpha, start_time, timeout);
        unmake_move(m, u);
        if (score >= beta) return beta;
        if (score > alpha) alpha = score;
    }
    return alpha;
}

Move find_best_move(double timeout_sec) {
    auto start_time = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    vector<Move> moves = generate_legal_moves();
    if (moves.empty()) {
        return {-1, -1, 0, false};
    }

    Move best = moves[0];
    int best_score = -10000000;

    // Iterative deepening limited by time
    for (int d = 1; d <= 6; d++) {
        auto now = chrono::steady_clock::now();
        double elapsed = chrono::duration<double>(now - start_time).count();
        if (elapsed > timeout_sec * 0.85) break;

        int alpha = -10000000;
        int beta = 10000000;
        Move local_best = moves[0];
        int local_best_score = -10000000;

        for (auto& m : moves) {
            now = chrono::steady_clock::now();
            elapsed = chrono::duration<double>(now - start_time).count();
            if (elapsed > timeout_sec * 0.85) break;

            UndoInfo u = make_move(m);
            int score = -alpha_beta(d - 1, -beta, -alpha, start_time, timeout_sec);
            unmake_move(m, u);

            if (score > local_best_score) {
                local_best_score = score;
                local_best = m;
            }
        }

        if (local_best_score > best_score) {
            best_score = local_best_score;
            best = local_best;
        }
    }

    return best;
}

string get_move_notation(Move m) {
    if (m.from < 0) return "O-O";
    char piece = board[m.from];
    string notation = "";
    if (tolower(piece) == 'p') {
        notation += "p";
    } else {
        notation += toupper(piece);
    }
    notation += sq_to_str(m.from);
    if (m.capture) notation += "x";
    notation += sq_to_str(m.to);
    if (m.promotion != 0) {
        notation += "/";
        notation += toupper(m.promotion);
    }
    if (tolower(piece) == 'k' && abs(m.to - m.from) == 2) {
        notation = (m.to > m.from ? "O-O" : "O-O-O");
    }
    return notation;
}

int main() {
    string timeout_str;
    getline(cin, timeout_str);
    double timeout = stod(timeout_str);
    string fen;
    getline(cin, fen);

    load_fen(fen);

    Move best = find_best_move(timeout);
    string move_str = get_move_notation(best);
    cout << move_str << endl;

    return 0;
}

Test 56: Delivery Route Planner (JavaScript) Score: 10.97 / 14
Typical Prompt:
Write a complete Node.js JavaScript program for this benchmark task.

Plan delivery routes for a fleet of vans.

The input JSON contains:
- `depot`: [x, y]
- `truckCount`: maximum number of vans/routes
- `packages`: objects `{id, x, y}`

Return JSON:
```
{"routes": [[packageId, packageId, ...], ...]}
```
Every package must appear exactly once. Each route starts and ends at the depot.
The score compares your total distance to a deterministic reference planner.

**Input format:**
The program receives one JSON document on stdin. Use this pattern to read it:
```
const fs = require('fs'); const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);
```

**Output format:**

const fs = require('fs');

const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

const depotCoords = data.depot;
const depot = { x: depotCoords[0], y: depotCoords[1] };
let packages = data.packages.map(p => ({ id: p.id, x: p.x, y: p.y }));
const truckCount = data.truckCount || 1;
const n = packages.length;

if (n === 0) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ routes: [] }));
  process.exit(0);
}

const K = Math.min(truckCount, n);

// Add angles for angular initialization
packages.forEach(p => {
  p.angle = Math.atan2(p.y - depot.y, p.x - depot.x);
});

const sortedByAngle = [...packages].sort((a, b) => a.angle - b.angle);

// Initialize centroids spread by angle
let centroids = [];
const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(n / K));
for (let i = 0; i < K; i++) {
  const idx = (i * step) % n;
  const p = sortedByAngle[idx];
  centroids.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y });
}

// K-means iterations
const maxIters = 25;
for (let iter = 0; iter < maxIters; iter++) {
  const assignment = new Array(n).fill(-1);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const p = packages[i];
    let minD = Infinity;
    let best = 0;
    for (let c = 0; c < K; c++) {
      const d = Math.hypot(p.x - centroids[c].x, p.y - centroids[c].y);
      if (d < minD) {
        minD = d;
        best = c;
      }
    }
    assignment[i] = best;
  }

  const sums = Array.from({ length: K }, () => ({ x: 0, y: 0, count: 0 }));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const c = assignment[i];
    sums[c].x += packages[i].x;
    sums[c].y += packages[i].y;
    sums[c].count++;
  }

  let changed = false;
  for (let c = 0; c < K; c++) {
    if (sums[c].count > 0) {
      const nx = sums[c].x / sums[c].count;
      const ny = sums[c].y / sums[c].count;
      if (Math.abs(nx - centroids[c].x) > 1e-5 || Math.abs(ny - centroids[c].y) > 1e-5) {
        changed = true;
      }
      centroids[c] = { x: nx, y: ny };
    }
  }
  if (!changed) break;
}

// Final assignment to clusters
const clusters = Array.from({ length: K }, () => []);
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
  const p = packages[i];
  let minD = Infinity;
  let best = 0;
  for (let c = 0; c < K; c++) {
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - centroids[c].x, p.y - centroids[c].y);
    if (d < minD) {
      minD = d;
      best = c;
    }
  }
  clusters[best].push(p);
}

// Nearest neighbor route builder for a cluster
function buildNNRoute(cluster, depot) {
  if (!cluster || cluster.length === 0) return [];
  let remaining = [...cluster];
  let current = { x: depot.x, y: depot.y };
  const route = [];
  while (remaining.length > 0) {
    let minD = Infinity;
    let bestIdx = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < remaining.length; i++) {
      const d = Math.hypot(remaining[i].x - current.x, remaining[i].y - current.y);
      if (d < minD) {
        minD = d;
        bestIdx = i;
      }
    }
    const nextP = remaining[bestIdx];
    route.push(nextP.id);
    current = { x: nextP.x, y: nextP.y };
    remaining.splice(bestIdx, 1);
  }
  return route;
}

const routes = clusters
  .map(cluster => buildNNRoute(cluster, depot))
  .filter(r => r.length > 0);

console.log(JSON.stringify({ routes }));

    <script>
        function createGridVisual(data, cutsSet) {
            const container = document.getElementById('grid-visual');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            container.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${data.width}, 22px)`;
            
            const ignSet = new Set(data.ignitions.map(i => `${i[0]},${i[1]}`));
            const townSet = new Set(data.towns.map(t => `${t.x},${t.y}`));
            
            for (let y = 0; y < data.height; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < data.width; x++) {
                    const cell = document.createElement('div');
                    cell.className = 'cell';
                    
                    const key = `${x},${y}`;
                    const isCut = cutsSet && cutsSet.has(key);
                    const isIgn = ignSet.has(key);
                    const isTown = townSet.has(key);
                    const isForest = data.grid[y] && data.grid[y][x] === '.';
                    
                    if (isCut) {
                        cell.classList.add('cut');
                        cell.textContent = '✂';
                    } else if (isIgn) {
                        cell.classList.add('ignition');
                        cell.textContent = '🔥';
                    } else if (isTown) {
                        cell.classList.add('town');
                        cell.textContent = '🏠';
                    } else if (isForest) {
                        cell.classList.add('forest');
                    } else {
                        cell.classList.add('water');
                        cell.style.background = '#0e7490';
                    }
                    
                    container.appendChild(cell);
                }
            }
        }
        
        function simulateFire(cutGrid, grid, ignitions, width, height) {
            const visited = Array.from({length: height}, () => Array(width).fill(false));
            const queue = [];
            let qStart = 0;
            
            for (const [x, y] of ignitions) {
                if (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height && 
                    grid[y][x] === '.' && !cutGrid[y][x]) {
                    if (!visited[y][x]) {
                        visited[y][x] = true;
                        queue.push([x, y]);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            const dirs = [[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]];
            
            while (qStart < queue.length) {
                const [x, y] = queue[qStart++];
                for (const [dx, dy] of dirs) {
                    const nx = x + dx;
                    const ny = y + dy;
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height &&
                        grid[ny][nx] === '.' && !cutGrid[ny][nx] && !visited[ny][nx]) {
                        visited[ny][nx] = true;
                        queue.push([nx, ny]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return visited;
        }
        
        function findPathToTarget(cutGrid, grid, ignitions, targetX, targetY, width, height) {
            const visited = Array.from({length: height}, () => Array(width).fill(false));
            const parent = Array.from({length: height}, () => Array(width).fill(null));
            const queue = [];
            let qStart = 0;
            let reachedTarget = false;
            
            const dirs = [[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]];
            
            for (const [sx, sy] of ignitions) {
                if (sx >= 0 && sx < width && sy >= 0 && sy < height &&
                    grid[sy][sx] === '.' && !cutGrid[sy][sx]) {
                    visited[sy][sx] = true;
                    parent[sy][sx] = [-1, -1];
                    queue.push([sx, sy]);
                    if (sx === targetX && sy === targetY) reachedTarget = true;
                }
            }
            
            if (reachedTarget) {
                return [[targetX, targetY]];
            }
            
            while (qStart < queue.length && !reachedTarget) {
                const [x, y] = queue[qStart++];
                for (const [dx, dy] of dirs) {
                    const nx = x + dx;
                    const ny = y + dy;
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height &&
                        grid[ny][nx] === '.' && !cutGrid[ny][nx] && !visited[ny][nx]) {
                        visited[ny][nx] = true;
                        parent[ny][nx] = [x, y];
                        queue.push([nx, ny]);
                        if (nx === targetX && ny === targetY) {
                            reachedTarget = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!reachedTarget || !parent[targetY] || parent[targetY][targetX] === null) {
                return null;
            }
            
            // Reconstruct path
            const path = [];
            let curX = targetX;
            let curY = targetY;
            
            while (true) {
                path.unshift([curX, curY]);
                const p = parent[curY][curX];
                if (!p || (p[0] === -1 && p[1] === -1)) {
                    break;
                }
                curX = p[0];
                curY = p[1];
            }
            
            return path;
        }
        
        function runAlgorithm() {
            const inputText = document.getElementById('input-json').value.trim();
            let data;
            
            try {
                data = JSON.parse(inputText);
            } catch(e) {
                alert("Invalid JSON input");
                return;
            }
            
            const { width, height, grid, ignitions, towns, cutBudget } = data;
            
            if (!grid || !ignitions || !towns) {
                alert("Missing required fields in input");
                return;
            }
            
            // Initialize cutGrid
            const cutGrid = Array.from({length: height}, () => new Array(width).fill(false));
            const cuts = [];
            
            // Main greedy loop
            for (let i = 0; i < cutBudget; i++) {
                // Simulate current fire
                const visited = simulateFire(cutGrid, grid, ignitions, width, height);
                
                // Find highest value threatened town
                let maxValue = 0;
                let target = null;
                
                for (const town of towns) {
                    const tx = town.x;
                    const ty = town.y;
                    if (tx >= 0 && tx < width && ty >= 0 && ty < height && 
                        visited[ty][tx] && town.value > maxValue) {
                        maxValue = town.value;
                        target = town;
                    }
                }
                
                if (!target) break;
                
                // Find path to target
                const path = findPathToTarget(cutGrid, grid, ignitions, target.x, target.y, width, height);
                
                if (!path || path.length === 0) break;
                
                // Select cut position: prefer cell before the town
                let cutIdx;
                if (path.length === 1) {
                    cutIdx = 0;
                } else {
                    cutIdx = path.length - 2;
                }
                
                const [cutX, cutY] = path[cutIdx];
                
                // Skip if already cut (shouldn't happen)
                if (cutGrid[cutY][cutX]) continue;
                
                // Place cut
                cutGrid[cutY][cutX] = true;
                cuts.push([cutX, cutY]);
            }
            
            // Prepare output
            const output = {
                firebreaks: cuts
            };
            
            // Display results
            const outputEl = document.getElementById('output-json');
            outputEl.textContent = JSON.stringify(output, null, 2);
            
            // Update visual
            const cutsSet = new Set(cuts.map(c => `${c[0]},${c[1]}`));
            createGridVisual(data, cutsSet);
            
            // Update budget display
            document.getElementById('budget-val').textContent = cutBudget;
            
            // Show a quick summary
            console.log('%c[Firebreak] Algorithm completed', 'color:#64748b', {
                cuts: cuts.length,
                budgetUsed: cuts.length,
                remainingBudget: cutBudget - cuts.length
            });
        }
        
        // Boot with demo
        window.onload = function() {
            const demoInput = document.getElementById('input-json');
            
            // Run demo automatically on load
            setTimeout(() => {
                runAlgorithm();
            }, 400);
            
            // Keyboard support
            demoInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    runAlgorithm();
                }
            });
        }
        
        // Expose for external testing
        window.runFirebreak = runAlgorithm;
    </script>

// Read input from stdin
const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim();
const data = JSON.parse(input);

const grid = data.grid || [];
const robots = data.robots || [];
const jobs = data.jobs || [];

const H = grid.length;
const W = H > 0 ? grid[0].length : 0;
const R = robots.length;
const J = jobs.length;

// Directions for BFS
const DIRS = [[0, 1], [0, -1], [1, 0], [-1, 0]];

// BFS to compute distance grid from a starting position
function computeDist(sx, sy) {
    if (sx < 0 || sx >= W || sy < 0 || sy >= H || grid[sy][sx] !== '.') {
        return null;
    }
    
    const dist = Array.from({ length: H }, () => Array(W).fill(-1));
    const queue = [];
    
    dist[sy][sx] = 0;
    queue.push([sy, sx]);
    
    let head = 0;
    while (head < queue.length) {
        const [y, x] = queue[head++];
        
        for (let [dy, dx] of DIRS) {
            const ny = y + dy;
            const nx = x + dx;
            
            if (ny >= 0 && ny < H && nx >= 0 && nx < W && 
                grid[ny][nx] === '.' && dist[ny][nx] === -1) {
                dist[ny][nx] = dist[y][x] + 1;
                queue.push([ny, nx]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dist;
}

// Precompute distance maps
const robotDistMaps = [];
for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
    const rx = robots[r].x;
    const ry = robots[r].y;
    robotDistMaps[r] = computeDist(rx, ry);
}

const jobDistMaps = [];
for (let j = 0; j < J; j++) {
    const jx = jobs[j].x;
    const jy = jobs[j].y;
    jobDistMaps[j] = computeDist(jx, jy);
}

// Build candidates: all (robot, job) pairs with distance
let candidates = [];
for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
    if (!robotDistMaps[r]) continue;
    for (let j = 0; j < J; j++) {
        const jy = jobs[j].y;
        const jx = jobs[j].x;
        const d = robotDistMaps[r][jy][jx];
        if (d >= 0) {
            candidates.push({ r, j, d });
        }
    }
}

// Sort candidates: smallest distance first, then by job id for determinism
candidates.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.d !== b.d) return a.d - b.d;
    const idA = jobs[a.j].id;
    const idB = jobs[b.j].id;
    if (idA < idB) return -1;
    if (idA > idB) return 1;
    return 0;
});

// Assign jobs greedily
const assignedJobs = new Array(J).fill(false);
const robotAssignedJobs = Array.from({ length: R }, () => []);

for (let cand of candidates) {
    if (!assignedJobs[cand.j]) {
        assignedJobs[cand.j] = true;
        robotAssignedJobs[cand.r].push(cand.j);
    }
}

// Assign any remaining jobs (fallback)
for (let j = 0; j < J; j++) {
    if (!assignedJobs[j]) {
        // Assign to first robot that can reach it, or robot 0
        let assigned = false;
        for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
            if (robotDistMaps[r]) {
                const d = robotDistMaps[r][jobs[j].y][jobs[j].x];
                if (d >= 0) {
                    robotAssignedJobs[r].push(j);
                    assignedJobs[j] = true;
                    assigned = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!assigned && R > 0) {
            robotAssignedJobs[0].push(j);
            assignedJobs[j] = true;
        }
    }
}

// Order jobs for each robot using nearest neighbor
const assignments = [];

for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
    const assignedJobIdxs = robotAssignedJobs[r];
    if (assignedJobIdxs.length === 0) {
        assignments.push([]);
        continue;
    }
    
    const ordered = [];
    const remaining = new Set(assignedJobIdxs);
    let lastJobIdx = null; // null means from robot position
    
    while (remaining.size > 0) {
        let minD = Infinity;
        let best = -1;
        
        for (let j of remaining) {
            let d = -1;
            
            const jy = jobs[j].y;
            const jx = jobs[j].x;
            
            if (lastJobIdx === null) {
                // From robot
                if (robotDistMaps[r]) {
                    d = robotDistMaps[r][jy][jx];
                }
            } else {
                // From previous job
                if (jobDistMaps[lastJobIdx]) {
                    d = jobDistMaps[lastJobIdx][jy][jx];
                }
            }
            
            if (d < 0) d = Infinity;
            
            let better = false;
            if (d < minD) {
                better = true;
            } else if (d === minD) {
                const idCurr = jobs[j].id;
                const idBest = jobs[best].id;
                if (idCurr < idBest) better = true;
            }
            
            if (better) {
                minD = d;
                best = j;
            }
        }
        
        if (best === -1) break;
        
        ordered.push(best);
        remaining.delete(best);
        lastJobIdx = best;
    }
    
    // Convert to job IDs
    const jobIds = ordered.map(jidx => jobs[jidx].id);
    assignments.push(jobIds);
}

// Output result
const output = { assignments };
console.log(JSON.stringify(output));

        <pre id="code"><code>const fs = require('fs');

const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim();
const data = JSON.parse(input);

const prob = data.probability;
const drones = data.drones || [];
const maxSteps = data.maxStepsPerDrone || 0;

const rows = prob.length;
const cols = rows > 0 ? prob[0].length : 0;

function isValid(x, y) {
    return x >= 0 && x < cols && y >= 0 && y < rows && prob[y][x] !== -1;
}

const moveDirs = [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]];

const covered = Array.from({ length: rows }, () => Array(cols).fill(false));
const paths = [];

for (let d = 0; d < drones.length; d++) {
    const drone = drones[d];
    let cx = drone.x;
    let cy = drone.y;
    
    let path = [[cx, cy]];
    
    if (prob[cy] && prob[cy][cx] > 0) {
        covered[cy][cx] = true;
    }
    
    let stepsLeft = maxSteps;
    
    while (stepsLeft > 0) {
        // BFS to find best target cell
        const queue = [];
        const visited = Array.from({ length: rows }, () => Array(cols).fill(false));
        const prevX = Array.from({ length: rows }, () => Array(cols).fill(-1));
        const prevY = Array.from({ length: rows }, () => Array(cols).fill(-1));
        
        queue.push({ x: cx, y: cy, dist: 0 });
        visited[cy][cx] = true;
        
        let bestScore = -1;
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        let targetX = cx;
        let targetY = cy;
        
        while (queue.length > 0) {
            const curr = queue.shift();
            const curx = curr.x;
            const cury = curr.y;
            const dist = curr.dist;
            
            if (dist > stepsLeft) continue;
            
            const cellVal = prob[cury] && prob[cury][curx] !== undefined ? prob[cury][curx] : -1;
            let curScore = (covered[cury][curx] || cellVal <= 0) ? -1 : cellVal;
            
            if (curScore > bestScore || (curScore === bestScore && dist < bestDist)) {
                bestScore = curScore;
                bestDist = dist;
                targetX = curx;
                targetY = cury;
            }
            
            for (const [dx, dy] of moveDirs) {
                const nx = curx + dx;
                const ny = cury + dy;
                
                if (isValid(nx, ny) && !visited[ny][nx] && dist + 1 <= stepsLeft) {
                    visited[ny][nx] = true;
                    queue.push({ x: nx, y: ny, dist: dist + 1 });
                    prevX[ny][nx] = curx;
                    prevY[ny][nx] = cury;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // If no valuable uncovered cell reachable
        if (bestScore <= 0) {
            for (let k = 0; k < stepsLeft; k++) {
                path.push([cx, cy]);
            }
            break;
        }
        
        // Reconstruct shortest path to target
        let segPath = [];
        let tx = targetX;
        let ty = targetY;
        
        while (!(tx === cx && ty === cy)) {
            segPath.unshift([tx, ty]);
            const px = prevX[ty][tx];
            const py = prevY[ty][tx];
            
            if (px === -1) break;
            
            tx = px;
            ty = py;
        }
        
        // Append path segments
        let moved = false;
        for (let i = 0; i < segPath.length && stepsLeft > 0; i++) {
            const [nx, ny] = segPath[i];
            path.push([nx, ny]);
            cx = nx;
            cy = ny;
            
            if (prob[cy] && prob[cy][cx] > 0 && !covered[cy][cx]) {
                covered[cy][cx] = true;
            }
            
            stepsLeft--;
            moved = true;
        }
        
        // Safety: if no movement happened, stay once and decrement
        if (!moved && stepsLeft > 0) {
            path.push([cx, cy]);
            stepsLeft--;
        }
    }
    
    // Ensure path has exactly maxSteps + 1 positions (pad with stays if needed)
    while (path.length < maxSteps + 1) {
        path.push([cx, cy]);
    }
    
    // Trim if somehow too long (shouldn't happen)
    if (path.length > maxSteps + 1) {
        path = path.slice(0, maxSteps + 1);
    }
    
    paths.push(path);
}

const output = { paths: paths };
console.log(JSON.stringify(output));</code></pre>

            <ul>
                <li>Reads JSON from stdin</li>
                <li>For each drone, uses BFS from current position to find the highest-value uncovered cell within remaining steps</li>
                <li>Moves along shortest valid path to that cell</li>
                <li>Updates global coverage to maximize unique probability</li>
                <li>Fills remaining steps with stays if needed</li>

    <h1>Node.js Mission Control Scheduler</h1>
    <p><strong>Complete runnable program below.</strong> Copy the code into a file (e.g. <code>scheduler.js</code>) and run with <code>node scheduler.js</code>.</p>
    
    <div class="note">
        <strong>Features:</strong><br>
        • Dependency-aware (DAG precedence)<br>
        • Multi-machine list scheduling with release times<br>
        • Critical path + earliest deadline + weight priority<br>
        • Handles machine idle time correctly<br>
        • Outputs full schedule with start times and machine assignments<br>
        • Scales to large instances (O(N²) acceptable for typical benchmark sizes)

<pre><code>const fs = require('fs');

// Read input from stdin
const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim();
let data;
try {
    data = JSON.parse(input);
} catch (e) {
    console.error("Invalid JSON input");
    process.exit(1);
}

const machineCount = data.machineCount || 1;
const tasks = data.tasks || [];

if (tasks.length === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ schedule: [] }));
    process.exit(0);
}

// Data structures
const taskMap = new Map();
const durationMap = new Map();
const deadlineMap = new Map();
const weightMap = new Map();
const successors = new Map();
const indegree = new Map();
const releaseTime = new Map();

for (let task of tasks) {
    const id = task.id;
    taskMap.set(id, task);
    durationMap.set(id, task.duration || 0);
    deadlineMap.set(id, task.deadline !== undefined ? task.deadline : Infinity);
    weightMap.set(id, task.weight || 1);
    releaseTime.set(id, 0);
    indegree.set(id, (task.deps && Array.isArray(task.deps)) ? task.deps.length : 0);
    successors.set(id, []);
}

// Build successors graph
for (let task of tasks) {
    const id = task.id;
    if (task.deps && Array.isArray(task.deps)) {
        for (let dep of task.deps) {
            if (!successors.has(dep)) {
                successors.set(dep, []);
            }
            successors.get(dep).push(id);
        }
    }
}

// Compute critical path (longest path sum of durations)
const critical = new Map();

function getCritical(id) {
    if (critical.has(id)) return critical.get(id);
    let maxLen = durationMap.get(id) || 0;
    const succs = successors.get(id) || [];
    for (let s of succs) {
        maxLen = Math.max(maxLen, (durationMap.get(id) || 0) + getCritical(s));
    }
    critical.set(id, maxLen);
    return maxLen;
}

for (let task of tasks) {
    getCritical(task.id);
}

// Initialize ready tasks
let ready = [];
for (let [id, deg] of indegree) {
    if (deg === 0) {
        ready.push(id);
    }
}

// Machine availability times
const machineFree = new Array(machineCount).fill(0);
const schedule = [];

// Helper: select best task from a list
function selectBestFromList(list) {
    if (!list || list.length === 0) return null;
    
    let bestId = list[0];
    let bestCrit = critical.get(bestId) || 0;
    let bestDl = deadlineMap.get(bestId) || Infinity;
    let bestW = weightMap.get(bestId) || 0;

    for (let i = 1; i &lt; list.length; i++) {
        const id = list[i];
        const crit = critical.get(id) || 0;
        const dl = deadlineMap.get(id) || Infinity;
        const w = weightMap.get(id) || 0;

        let better = false;
        if (crit &gt; bestCrit) {
            better = true;
        } else if (crit === bestCrit) {
            if (dl &lt; bestDl) {
                better = true;
            } else if (dl === bestDl &amp;&amp; w &gt; bestW) {
                better = true;
            }
        }
        if (better) {
            bestId = id;
            bestCrit = crit;
            bestDl = dl;
            bestW = w;
        }
    }
    return bestId;
}

// Main scheduling loop
let scheduledCount = 0;
const totalTasks = tasks.length;

while (ready.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; scheduledCount &lt; totalTasks) {
    // Find machine with earliest availability
    let minM = 0;
    let avail = machineFree[0];
    for (let m = 1; m &lt; machineCount; m++) {
        if (machineFree[m] &lt; avail) {
            avail = machineFree[m];
            minM = m;
        }
    }

    // Find candidates that can start at or before avail
    let candidates = [];
    let minR = Infinity;
    
    for (let id of ready) {
        const r = releaseTime.get(id) || 0;
        if (r &lt;= avail) {
            candidates.push(id);
        } else if (r &lt; minR) {
            minR = r;
        }
    }

    let chosenId;
    let start;

    if (candidates.length &gt; 0) {
        // Schedule a ready task now
        chosenId = selectBestFromList(candidates);
        start = avail;
    } else {
        // All ready tasks have future release times — wait for the earliest
        minR = Infinity;
        for (let id of ready) {
            const r = releaseTime.get(id) || 0;
            if (r &lt; minR) minR = r;
        }
        
        candidates = [];
        for (let id of ready) {
            if ((releaseTime.get(id) || 0) &lt;= minR) {
                candidates.push(id);
            }
        }
        chosenId = selectBestFromList(candidates);
        start = minR;
    }

    if (!chosenId) break;

    // Remove from ready
    const idx = ready.indexOf(chosenId);
    if (idx !== -1) ready.splice(idx, 1);

    const dur = durationMap.get(chosenId) || 0;
    const finish = start + dur;

    // Record schedule
    schedule.push({
        id: chosenId,
        start: start,
        machine: minM
    });

    // Update machine availability
    machineFree[minM] = finish;

    // Update successors
    const succs = successors.get(chosenId) || [];
    for (let s of succs) {
        const currRel = releaseTime.get(s) || 0;
        if (finish &gt; currRel) {
            releaseTime.set(s, finish);
        }
        let deg = indegree.get(s) || 0;
        deg--;
        if (deg &lt; 0) deg = 0;
        indegree.set(s, deg);
        
        if (deg === 0) {
            ready.push(s);
        }
    }

    scheduledCount++;
}

// Output
const output = {
    schedule: schedule
};

console.log(JSON.stringify(output));
</code></pre>

declare const require: any;

const fs = require('fs');

const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

interface Package {
    id: any;
    x: number;
    y: number;
}

interface InputData {
    depot: [number, number];
    truckCount: number;
    packages: Package[];
}

const inputData: InputData = data;

const depotPoint = { x: inputData.depot[0], y: inputData.depot[1] };
const K = Math.max(1, Math.min(inputData.truckCount, inputData.packages.length || 0));
const packages: Package[] = inputData.packages || [];

function distance(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }): number {
    return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
}

function getAngle(p: { x: number; y: number }, center: { x: number; y: number }): number {
    return Math.atan2(p.y - center.y, p.x - center.x);
}

function orderRoute(cluster: Package[], depot: { x: number; y: number }): any[] {
    if (cluster.length === 0) return [];
    
    const remaining = [...cluster];
    const route: any[] = [];
    let current = depot;
    
    while (remaining.length > 0) {
        let minDist = Infinity;
        let bestIdx = -1;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < remaining.length; i++) {
            const d = distance(current, remaining[i]);
            if (d < minDist) {
                minDist = d;
                bestIdx = i;
            }
        }
        
        const nextPkg = remaining[bestIdx];
        route.push(nextPkg.id);
        current = nextPkg;
        remaining.splice(bestIdx, 1);
    }
    
    return route;
}

// Sweep clustering by polar angle
const sortedPackages = [...packages].sort((a, b) => {
    const angleA = getAngle(a, depotPoint);
    const angleB = getAngle(b, depotPoint);
    if (angleA !== angleB) return angleA - angleB;
    // Tie-break by distance from depot
    return distance(a, depotPoint) - distance(b, depotPoint);
});

const n = sortedPackages.length;
const routes: any[][] = [];

if (n > 0 && K > 0) {
    const baseSize = Math.floor(n / K);
    const remainder = n % K;
    let start = 0;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        const size = baseSize + (i < remainder ? 1 : 0);
        if (size > 0 && start < n) {
            const cluster = sortedPackages.slice(start, start + size);
            const route = orderRoute(cluster, depotPoint);
            if (route.length > 0) {
                routes.push(route);
            }
            start += size;
        }
    }
}

// Ensure all packages are covered (fallback for edge cases)
if (routes.length === 0 && n > 0) {
    // Fallback: all in one route
    const route = orderRoute(sortedPackages, depotPoint);
    if (route.length > 0) routes.push(route);
} else if (n > 0) {
    // Verify coverage and fix if needed (rare)
    const used = new Set<any>();
    for (const r of routes) {
        for (const id of r) used.add(id);
    }
    const missing: Package[] = [];
    for (const p of packages) {
        if (!used.has(p.id)) missing.push(p);
    }
    if (missing.length > 0) {
        const fallbackRoute = orderRoute(missing, depotPoint);
        if (fallbackRoute.length > 0) routes.push(fallbackRoute);
    }
}

const output = { routes };
console.log(JSON.stringify(output));

Fire spreads in four directions through burnable cells. Water/rock and your cut

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');

const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data: any = JSON.parse(input);

const width: number = data.width;
const height: number = data.height;
const grid: string[] = data.grid;
const ignitions: number[][] = data.ignitions;
const towns: { id: number; x: number; y: number; value: number }[] = data.towns;
const cutBudget: number = data.cutBudget;

const dirs: number[][] = [[0, 1], [1, 0], [0, -1], [-1, 0]];

function getReachableCells(
  grid: string[],
  width: number,
  height: number,
  ignitions: number[][],
  cuts: boolean[][]
): boolean[][] {
  const reachable: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: height }, () => Array(width).fill(false));
  const q: [number, number][] = [];
  let head = 0;

  for (const [x, y] of ignitions) {
    if (y >= 0 && y < height && x >= 0 && x < width && grid[y][x] === '.' && !cuts[y][x]) {
      reachable[y][x] = true;
      q.push([x, y]);
    }
  }

  while (head < q.length) {
    const [x, y] = q[head++];
    for (const [dx, dy] of dirs) {
      const nx = x + dx;
      const ny = y + dy;
      if (
        nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height &&
        grid[ny][nx] === '.' && !reachable[ny][nx] && !cuts[ny][nx]
      ) {
        reachable[ny][nx] = true;
        q.push([nx, ny]);
      }
    }
  }
  return reachable;
}

function computeDistFromIgn(
  grid: string[],
  width: number,
  height: number,
  ignitions: number[][],
  cuts: boolean[][]
): number[][] {
  const dist: number[][] = Array.from({ length: height }, () => Array(width).fill(Infinity));
  const q: [number, number][] = [];
  let head = 0;

  for (const [x, y] of ignitions) {
    if (y >= 0 && y < height && x >= 0 && x < width && grid[y][x] === '.' && !cuts[y][x]) {
      dist[y][x] = 0;
      q.push([x, y]);
    }
  }

  while (head < q.length) {
    const [x, y] = q[head++];
    for (const [dx, dy] of dirs) {
      const nx = x + dx;
      const ny = y + dy;
      if (
        nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height &&
        grid[ny][nx] === '.' && dist[ny][nx] === Infinity && !cuts[ny][nx]
      ) {
        dist[ny][nx] = dist[y][x] + 1;
        q.push([nx, ny]);
      }
    }
  }
  return dist;
}

function findCellToCut(
  town: { x: number; y: number; value: number },
  ignitions: number[][],
  cuts: boolean[][],
  grid: string[],
  width: number,
  height: number,
  distFromIgn: number[][]
): [number, number] | null {
  const visited: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: height }, () => Array(width).fill(false));
  const parent: ([number, number] | null)[][] = Array.from({ length: height }, () => Array(width).fill(null));
  const q: [number, number][] = [];
  let head = 0;

  const tx = town.x;
  const ty = town.y;

  if (cuts[ty][tx]) return null;

  visited[ty][tx] = true;
  parent[ty][tx] = null;
  q.push([tx, ty]);

  let reached: [number, number] | null = null;

  while (head < q.length) {
    const [x, y] = q[head++];

    const isIgn = ignitions.some(([ix, iy]) => ix === x && iy === y);
    if (isIgn && !cuts[y][x]) {
      reached = [x, y];
      break;
    }

    for (const [dx, dy] of dirs) {
      const nx = x + dx;
      const ny = y + dy;
      if (
        nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height &&
        grid[ny][nx] === '.' && !visited[ny][nx] && !cuts[ny][nx]
      ) {
        visited[ny][nx] = true;
        parent[ny][nx] = [x, y];
        q.push([nx, ny]);
      }
    }
  }

  if (!reached) return null;

  // Reconstruct path from ignition back to town
  const path: [number, number][] = [];
  let curr: [number, number] | null = reached;
  while (curr !== null) {
    path.push(curr);
    const p = parent[curr[1]][curr[0]];
    if (p === null) break;
    curr = p;
  }

  // path[0] = ignition, path[path.length-1] = town
  if (path.length <= 1) return null;

  // Choose best cell: prefer lowest distFromIgn, skip ignition and town
  let bestCell: [number, number] | null = null;
  let bestD = Infinity;

  for (let i = 1; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
    const [cx, cy] = path[i];
    const d = distFromIgn[cy][cx];
    if (d < bestD && d < Infinity) {
      bestD = d;
      bestCell = [cx, cy];
    }
  }

  if (bestCell) return bestCell;

  // Fallback: pick cell next to ignition (path[1])
  if (path.length >= 2) {
    const [cx, cy] = path[1];
    const isTown = cx === tx && cy === ty;
    if (!isTown) {
      return [cx, cy];
    }
  }

  return null;
}

const initialCuts: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: height }, () => Array(width).fill(false));
const initialReach = getReachableCells(grid, width, height, ignitions, initialCuts);

const threatenedTowns = towns
  .filter((town) => {
    const { x, y } = town;
    return x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height && initialReach[y][x];
  })
  .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

const cuts: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: height }, () => Array(width).fill(false));
let cutsMade = 0;
const distFromIgn = computeDistFromIgn(grid, width, height, ignitions, cuts);

const maxIter = Math.min(300, cutBudget * 2 + 10);
let iterations = 0;
let changed = true;

while (changed && cutsMade < cutBudget && iterations < maxIter) {
  changed = false;
  iterations++;

  for (const town of threatenedTowns) {
    if (cutsMade >= cutBudget) break;

    const currReach = getReachableCells(grid, width, height, ignitions, cuts);
    if (!currReach[town.y][town.x]) continue;

    const cell = findCellToCut(town, ignitions, cuts, grid, width, height, distFromIgn);
    if (cell) {
      const [cx, cy] = cell;
      if (!cuts[cy][cx] && grid[cy][cx] === '.') {
        const isTownPos = towns.some((t) => t.x === cx && t.y === cy);
        if (!isTownPos) {
          cuts[cy][cx] = true;
          cutsMade++;
          changed = true;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// Collect firebreaks
const firebreaks: number[][] = [];
for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
  for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
    if (cuts[y][x]) {
      firebreaks.push([x, y]);
    }
  }
}

console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks }));

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');

const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

interface Robot {
  id: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

interface Job {
  id: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  priority: number;
}

const grid: string[] = data.grid || [];
const robotsInput: Robot[] = data.robots || [];
const jobsInput: Job[] = data.jobs || [];

if (grid.length === 0) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ assignments: [] }));
  process.exit(0);
}

const robots: Robot[] = [...robotsInput].sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
const jobs: Job[] = [...jobsInput];

function getKey(x: number, y: number): string {
  return `${x},${y}`;
}

const relevant = new Set<string>();
for (const r of robots) {
  relevant.add(getKey(r.x, r.y));
}
for (const j of jobs) {
  relevant.add(getKey(j.x, j.y));
}

function computeDistsFrom(
  grid: string[],
  sx: number,
  sy: number,
  relevant: Set<string>
): Map<string, number> {
  const height = grid.length;
  const width = grid[0].length;
  const visited: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: height }, () =>
    Array(width).fill(false)
  );
  const queue: Array<{ x: number; y: number; d: number }> = [];
  const result = new Map<string, number>();
  const startKey = getKey(sx, sy);

  if (relevant.has(startKey)) {
    result.set(startKey, 0);
  }

  if (sy < height && sx < width && grid[sy][sx] !== '#') {
    visited[sy][sx] = true;
    queue.push({ x: sx, y: sy, d: 0 });
  }

  const dirs: number[][] = [
    [-1, 0],
    [1, 0],
    [0, -1],
    [0, 1],
  ];

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const curr = queue.shift()!;
    const { x, y, d } = curr;

    for (const [dx, dy] of dirs) {
      const nx = x + dx;
      const ny = y + dy;
      if (
        nx >= 0 &&
        nx < width &&
        ny >= 0 &&
        ny < height &&
        !visited[ny][nx] &&
        grid[ny][nx] !== '#'
      ) {
        visited[ny][nx] = true;
        const nd = d + 1;
        const nkey = getKey(nx, ny);
        if (relevant.has(nkey)) {
          result.set(nkey, nd);
        }
        queue.push({ x: nx, y: ny, d: nd });
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
}

const allDists = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>();
for (const key of relevant) {
  const [sx, sy] = key.split(',').map(Number);
  const distMap = computeDistsFrom(grid, sx, sy, relevant);
  allDists.set(key, distMap);
}

function getDist(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): number {
  const k1 = getKey(x1, y1);
  const k2 = getKey(x2, y2);
  if (k1 === k2) return 0;
  const map1 = allDists.get(k1);
  if (!map1) return Infinity;
  const dist = map1.get(k2);
  return dist !== undefined ? dist : Infinity;
}

jobs.sort((a, b) => {
  if (a.priority !== b.priority) {
    return b.priority - a.priority;
  }
  return a.id - b.id;
});

const currentPos: { x: number; y: number }[] = robots.map((r) => ({
  x: r.x,
  y: r.y,
}));
const assignments: number[][] = robots.map(() => []);

for (const job of jobs) {
  let bestIdx = -1;
  let minDist = Infinity;
  const jx = job.x;
  const jy = job.y;

  for (let i = 0; i < robots.length; i++) {
    const d = getDist(currentPos[i].x, currentPos[i].y, jx, jy);
    if (
      d < minDist ||
      (d === minDist && (bestIdx === -1 || i < bestIdx))
    ) {
      minDist = d;
      bestIdx = i;
    }
  }

  if (bestIdx !== -1 && minDist < Infinity) {
    assignments[bestIdx].push(job.id);
    currentPos[bestIdx] = { x: jx, y: jy };
  } else if (robots.length > 0) {
    assignments[0].push(job.id);
    currentPos[0] = { x: jx, y: jy };
  }
}

const output = { assignments };
console.log(JSON.stringify(output));

declare const require: any;

const fs = require('fs');

const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim();
const data: any = JSON.parse(input);

const probability: number[][] = data.probability;
const drones: { id: number; x: number; y: number }[] = data.drones || [];
const maxStepsPerDrone: number = data.maxStepsPerDrone || 0;

const rows: number = probability.length;
let cols: number = 0;
if (rows > 0) {
  cols = probability[0].length;
}

function isValid(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (y < 0 || y >= rows || x < 0 || x >= cols) return false;
  return probability[y][x] !== -1;
}

const directions: number[][] = [
  [0, 0],   // stay
  [0, -1],  // up
  [0, 1],   // down
  [-1, 0],  // left
  [1, 0]    // right
];

const covered: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: rows }, () => Array(cols).fill(false));
const paths: number[][][] = [];

for (const drone of drones) {
  const sx: number = drone.x;
  const sy: number = drone.y;

  if (!isValid(sx, sy)) {
    paths.push([[sx, sy]]);
    continue;
  }

  const path: number[][] = [[sx, sy]];
  let x: number = sx;
  let y: number = sy;
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  visited.add(`${x},${y}`);
  covered[y][x] = true;

  for (let step = 0; step < maxStepsPerDrone; step++) {
    let bestScore = -Infinity;
    let bestX = x;
    let bestY = y;

    for (const [dx, dy] of directions) {
      const nx = x + dx;
      const ny = y + dy;

      if (!isValid(nx, ny)) continue;

      const key = `${nx},${ny}`;
      let score = probability[ny][nx];

      if (covered[ny][nx]) {
        score -= 120;
      } else {
        score += 65;
      }

      if (visited.has(key)) {
        score -= 45;
      } else {
        score += 25;
      }

      if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        bestX = nx;
        bestY = ny;
      }
    }

    x = bestX;
    y = bestY;
    path.push([x, y]);
    visited.add(`${x},${y}`);
    covered[y][x] = true;
  }

  paths.push(path);
}

const output = { paths: paths };
console.log(JSON.stringify(output));

declare const require: any;

const fs = require('fs');

const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

interface Task {
  id: any;
  duration: number;
  deps: any[];
  deadline?: number;
  weight?: number;
}

const machineCount: number = data.machineCount || 1;
const tasksInput: Task[] = data.tasks || [];

const taskMap = new Map<string, Task & { deps: string[] }>();
for (const t of tasksInput) {
  const strId = String(t.id);
  taskMap.set(strId, {
    id: t.id,
    duration: t.duration || 0,
    deps: (t.deps || []).map((d: any) => String(d)),
    deadline: t.deadline,
    weight: t.weight
  });
}

const successors = new Map<string, string[]>();
const indegreeMap = new Map<string, number>();
const remainingIndegree = new Map<string, number>();
const maxPredFinish = new Map<string, number>();

for (const id of taskMap.keys()) {
  successors.set(id, []);
  indegreeMap.set(id, 0);
  remainingIndegree.set(id, 0);
  maxPredFinish.set(id, 0);
}

for (const [id, task] of taskMap.entries()) {
  for (const dep of task.deps) {
    if (successors.has(dep)) {
      successors.get(dep)!.push(id);
    }
    const curr = indegreeMap.get(id)!;
    indegreeMap.set(id, curr + 1);
  }
}

for (const id of taskMap.keys()) {
  remainingIndegree.set(id, indegreeMap.get(id)!);
}

const longestPath = new Map<string, number>();

function getLongestPath(id: string): number {
  if (longestPath.has(id)) {
    return longestPath.get(id)!;
  }
  let maxLen = 0;
  const succList = successors.get(id) || [];
  for (const s of succList) {
    maxLen = Math.max(maxLen, getLongestPath(s));
  }
  const dur = taskMap.get(id)!.duration;
  const res = dur + maxLen;
  longestPath.set(id, res);
  return res;
}

for (const id of taskMap.keys()) {
  getLongestPath(id);
}

const ready: string[] = [];
for (const id of taskMap.keys()) {
  if (remainingIndegree.get(id) === 0) {
    ready.push(id);
  }
}

const machineFreeTimes: number[] = new Array(machineCount).fill(0);
const startTimes = new Map<string, number>();
const finishTimes = new Map<string, number>();
const assignedMachines = new Map<string, number>();

while (ready.length > 0) {
  // Find earliest free machine
  let minFreeTime = Infinity;
  let bestMachine = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < machineCount; i++) {
    if (machineFreeTimes[i] < minFreeTime) {
      minFreeTime = machineFreeTimes[i];
      bestMachine = i;
    }
  }

  // Find highest priority ready task (critical path first, then deadline, then weight)
  let bestIdx = 0;
  let bestPrio = -Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) {
    const tid = ready[i];
    let prio = longestPath.get(tid) || 0;

    if (prio > bestPrio) {
      bestPrio = prio;
      bestIdx = i;
    } else if (prio === bestPrio) {
      const tA = taskMap.get(tid)!;
      const tB = taskMap.get(ready[bestIdx])!;
      const dA = tA.deadline ?? Infinity;
      const dB = tB.deadline ?? Infinity;
      if (dA < dB) {
        bestIdx = i;
      } else if (dA === dB) {
        const wA = tA.weight ?? 0;
        const wB = tB.weight ?? 0;
        if (wA > wB) {
          bestIdx = i;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const taskId = ready.splice(bestIdx, 1)[0];
  const task = taskMap.get(taskId)!;
  const est = maxPredFinish.get(taskId) || 0;
  const start = Math.max(est, minFreeTime);
  const finish = start + task.duration;

  startTimes.set(taskId, start);
  finishTimes.set(taskId, finish);
  assignedMachines.set(taskId, bestMachine);
  machineFreeTimes[bestMachine] = finish;

  // Propagate to successors
  const succList = successors.get(taskId) || [];
  for (const succId of succList) {
    const currMax = maxPredFinish.get(succId) || 0;
    if (finish > currMax) {
      maxPredFinish.set(succId, finish);
    }
    let rem = remainingIndegree.get(succId)!;
    rem--;
    remainingIndegree.set(succId, rem);
    if (rem === 0) {
      ready.push(succId);
    }
  }
}

const schedule: { id: any; start: number; machine: number }[] = [];
for (const [strId, task] of taskMap.entries()) {
  const start = startTimes.get(strId);
  const mach = assignedMachines.get(strId);
  if (start !== undefined && mach !== undefined) {
    schedule.push({
      id: task.id,
      start: start,
      machine: mach
    });
  }
}

const output = { schedule };
console.log(JSON.stringify(output));
